### Combobox (`combobox`)

ComboboxTrigger offers a field-style button (size auto/sm/md/lg), or a custom element through render. ComboboxContent accepts optional header and footer slots; put ComboboxPopupInput in header to focus search on open. The popup input uses the localized search placeholder and shares virtualized keyboard navigation. Optional listClassName and emptyClassName customize presentation. With no slots the original input/list structure is preserved. See ComboboxPopupSearch for the trigger, header and footer together. Searchable select: typing filters the list. Single select (ComboboxInput) or multi-select with removable chips (ComboboxChipsInput), an announced empty state, and rich rows via ComboboxItem children. Async options (`loadOptions(query, { signal })`: debounced, stale requests aborted, announced loading and error states with a Retry row) and creatable (`onCreate(input)` adds a “Create …” row). Opt-in `virtualized` windows flat items arrays (including async, Create and Retry rows); grouped items and static children retain full rendering. ComboboxContent accepts itemHeight (fixed pixels), estimatedItemHeight (default 32) and overscan (default 4). Keyboard highlights stay mounted; filtering resets scroll and reopening reveals the selection. Find-in-page and screen-reader browse mode reach mounted rows only; keyboard navigation reaches all options. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries. Grouped `{ value, items }` collections use ComboboxGroup, ComboboxGroupLabel, ComboboxSeparator and ComboboxCollection. Pass each filtered group's items to ComboboxGroup; ComboboxCollection renders its options (renderless unless className supplies a container). Labels and separators share Select styles. useComboboxFilter exposes Base UI's locale-aware matching for custom filters. Filtering hides empty groups and labels; keyboard navigation crosses groups. Async results may be grouped, and Create/Retry rows stay outside groups. See ComboboxGrouped for grouped creatable and async previews.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Combobox` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Combobox/Combobox.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/combobox`
- ARIA pattern: combobox (list autocomplete) + listbox
- Registry dependencies: select, spinner, ui-utils, virtual-list
- Install: `gntik-ui add combobox`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject combobox`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown on ComboboxTrigger | Opens the popup and focuses ComboboxPopupInput in the header |
| Home / End, PageUp / PageDown | Virtualized: jumps to the first / last option or moves by a viewport |
| Type a character | Opens the popup and filters the options |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Opens the popup and moves the highlight between options |
| Enter | Selects the highlighted option (adds a chip in multi-select) |
| Escape | Closes the popup, keeping focus in the input |
| Backspace | Multi-select, empty input: removes the last chip |
| Enter on “Create …” / “Retry” | Creates an item from the typed text (onCreate) / loads the options again after an error |

Tokens: background, border, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-text, secondary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { matchText } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

interface Member {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  email: string;
}

const DIRECTORY: Member[] = [
  { value: 'emma', label: 'Emma Crown', email: 'emma@example.com' },
  { value: 'leo', label: 'Leo Park', email: 'leo@example.com' },
  { value: 'mara', label: 'Mara Vidal', email: 'mara@example.com' },
  { value: 'noah', label: 'Noah Frey', email: 'noah@example.com' },
  { value: 'ines', label: 'Ines Roca', email: 'ines@example.com' },
  { value: 'omar', label: 'Omar Haddad', email: 'omar@example.com' },
  { value: 'yuki', label: 'Yuki Sato', email: 'yuki@example.com' },
];

/** Stands in for `fetch('/api/members?q=…', { signal })`: resolves after a short delay, honours abort. */
function searchMembers(query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }, locale?: string): Promise<Member[]> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      resolve(DIRECTORY.filter((m) => matchText(`${m.label} ${m.email}`, query, { locale })));
    }, 300);
    signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
    });
  });
}

export default function ComboboxAsync() {
  const { locale } = useI18n();
  const loadOptions = useCallback(
    (query: string, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => searchMembers(query, context, locale),
    [locale],
  );
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <Combobox<Member> loadOptions={loadOptions} debounceMs={250}>
        <ComboboxInput label="Assignee" placeholder="Search the directory…" showClear />
        <ComboboxContent emptyText="No members match.">
          {(m: Member) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={m.value} value={m}>
              <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col leading-tight">
                <span className="truncate font-medium">{m.label}</span>
                <span className="truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{m.email}</span>
              </span>
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </ComboboxContent>
      </Combobox>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">Results load as you type; stale requests are cancelled.</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### DateField (`date-field`)

Typed local date and date-time entry in Intl locale order. DateField and DateRangeField expose named spinbuttons, calendar/min/max/disabled-date validation, ISO or numeric locale paste, and hidden form values. Granularity adds hours, minutes or seconds; a 12-hour clock adds AM/PM. Two-digit years remain literal (26 means year 26); empty segments use the TimePicker placeholder. forceLeadingZeros pads supplied values; typed segments are padded. Works inside Field. DatePicker triggers remain read-only.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `DateField` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/DateField/DateField.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/field (control) + spinbutton segments`
- ARIA pattern: group of spinbuttons (date field)
- Registry dependencies: calendar, time-picker, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add date-field`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject date-field`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves between segments, then out of the field; finishes a partially typed year |
| 0–9 | Types digits and advances when full; years accept up to four digits |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Increments / decrements and wraps within the segment; day bounds follow month and leap year |
| Home / End | Sets the focused segment to its minimum / maximum |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | Moves to the previous / next segment, including across a range |
| Backspace / Delete | Clears the segment and submitted value |
| A / P | On the AM/PM segment: selects AM / PM |
| Paste | Fills from ISO date/date-time or locale-ordered numeric date; ignores other text |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, primary-chip-text, secondary, destructive, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Field, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { DateField } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function DateFieldBasic() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [date, setDate] = useState<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 9, 1));
  return (
    <Field className="max-w-sm">
      <FieldLabel>{t('dateField.label')}</FieldLabel>
      <DateField value={date} onValueChange={setDate} name="date" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### DatePicker (`date-picker`)

Date field with a focusable trigger ref: a read-only input with the Intl-formatted date that opens a Popover with a Calendar. DateRangePicker (alias DateRangeInput) adds presets — Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month, Custom — beside a two-month range calendar. Min/max, disabled dates, locale, sizes, invalid state; works inside Field. `withTime` adds a TimePicker under the calendar (date + time value, 12/24h, minute step), closed with Done. DatePicker and DateRangePicker accept ref on their input; calling focus leaves the popup closed. Both pickers support `clearable`, `onClear` and `clearLabel`: reset from the field button, Delete/Backspace, or the popup Clear action. Clearing closes the popup and restores field focus. `readOnly` prevents edits. DatePicker accepts `timeZone` (IANA, UTC or system), defaulting to I18nProvider then the browser; invalid names fall back to the browser. Calendar days, today, min/max, time segments and edits use that wall clock while values stay Date instants. isDateDisabled receives a local-midnight proxy of the zoned calendar day. DST gaps move forward and overlaps choose the earlier occurrence. Non-system zones appear in field text and time labels unless `hideTimeZone` is true. With time, hidden values include the wall time and UTC offset (and seconds with `withSeconds`); date-only values submit YYYY-MM-DD and emit zoned midnight. Custom formatOptions retain their format but use the effective zone. DatePickerUtc demonstrates UTC, seconds, hidden zone labels and a provider-inherited date-only zone; DateRangePicker is unchanged. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries. The internal calendar selectors and time field in the popup stay outlined, including inside a ghost or filled provider.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `DatePicker` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/DatePicker/DatePicker.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/popover + Calendar (+ TimePicker with `withTime`)`
- ARIA pattern: combobox with a dialog popup (date picker dialog)
- Registry dependencies: button, calendar, popover, time-picker, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add date-picker`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject date-picker`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Delete / Backspace | With clearable on a non-empty editable trigger: clears and keeps focus |
| Enter / Space | On the field: opens the calendar with focus on the selected day (or today) |
| Arrow keys / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End | Move through the calendar (see Calendar) |
| Enter | In the calendar: picks the day (range: start, then end) and closes (`withTime`: stays open) |
| Escape | Closes the popup and returns focus to the field |
| Tab | `withTime`: from the calendar to the time segments and Done (see TimePicker for their keys) |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, popover, primary, primary-text, secondary, destructive, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { DatePicker } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const today = new Date(2026, 5, 15);
const isWeekend = (d: Date) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6;

export default function DatePickerBasic() {
  const [release, setRelease] = useState<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 5, 18));
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Release date</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker
          value={release}
          onValueChange={setRelease}
          locale="en-US"
          weekStartsOn={1}
          today={today}
          min={today}
          isDateDisabled={isWeekend}
          name="release"
        />
        <FieldDescription>Releases ship on weekdays only.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Invoice due</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker locale="en-US" today={today} formatOptions={{ dateStyle: 'long' }} invalid />
        <FieldError match>Choose a due date.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Contract start</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker defaultValue={new Date(2026, 0, 1)} locale="en-US" disabled />
      </Field>
      <DatePicker aria-label="Report date" size="sm" locale="en-US" today={today} placeholder="Any day" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### DateTimeRangePicker (`date-time-range-picker`)

Time range field for logs and metrics: quick presets (last 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, custom), a relative "Last N minutes/hours/days" mode and an absolute mode with a range Calendar plus start and end TimePickers, validated so the end is after the start. The value is serialisable: `{ mode: "relative", amount, unit }` or `{ mode: "absolute", start, end }`; `resolveTimeRange` turns it into instants. `timeZone` (IANA, UTC or system) defaults to I18nProvider then the browser; invalid names fall back to the browser. Absolute calendar days, today, min/max, time segments and edits use the zone, with compatible DST disambiguation (gaps move forward; overlaps choose the earlier instant). Non-system zones appear in the field text and start/end labels; `hideTimeZone` removes those labels. Relative presets remain instant-based and hidden start/end inputs remain ISO instants. DateTimeRangePickerUtc demonstrates UTC absolute editing and hidden zone labels.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `DateTimeRangePicker` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/DateTimeRangePicker/DateTimeRangePicker.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/popover + Calendar, TimePicker, NumberInput, Select, ToggleGroup`
- ARIA pattern: combobox with a dialog popup
- Registry dependencies: button, calendar, date-picker, number-input, popover, select, time-picker, toggle-group, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add date-time-range-picker`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject date-time-range-picker`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | On the field: opens the popup with focus on the active preset |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves through presets, the mode switch, the editors and Apply |
| Enter / Space | On a preset: applies it and closes; on Custom range: switches to absolute mode and focuses the calendar |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | In the mode switch: moves between Relative and Absolute |
| Arrow keys / PageUp / PageDown | In the calendar: move between days (see Calendar); in the time fields: spin (see TimePicker) |
| Escape | Closes the popup without applying and returns focus to the field |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, popover, primary, primary-chip-text, secondary, destructive-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { DateTimeRangePicker } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import type { TimeRangeValue } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const now = new Date(2026, 5, 15, 12, 0);

export default function DateTimeRangePickerBasic() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<TimeRangeValue | null>({ mode: 'relative', amount: 24, unit: 'hour' });
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Log window</FieldLabel>
        <DateTimeRangePicker
          value={range}
          onValueChange={setRange}
          locale="en-US"
          hourCycle={24}
          now={now}
          name="window"
        />
        <FieldDescription>Relative ranges end now; custom ranges are absolute.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Incident period</FieldLabel>
        <DateTimeRangePicker
          defaultValue={{ mode: 'absolute', start: new Date(2026, 5, 12, 8, 30), end: new Date(2026, 5, 12, 11, 0) }}
          locale="en-US"
          hourCycle={24}
          now={now}
          max={now}
        />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Dropzone (`dropzone`)

A file target with accept/reject feedback, a picker, type/size/count validation and a headless useDropzone hook. Accept is an input-style string or string array. With activateOnClick (default), children must contain no interactive content; use activateOnClick=false with DropzoneTrigger for buttons. Safari can expose an empty MIME type while dragging: these files are provisionally accepted and validated on drop. Extension and size rules apply on drop. Mount only one fullScreen zone per page; its window listeners ignore non-file drags. DropzoneCaption uses accept and maxSize for the upload hint. multiple defaults to true. Disabled zones ignore interaction.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Dropzone` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Dropzone/Dropzone.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/use-render`
- ARIA pattern: Button
- Registry dependencies: button, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add dropzone`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject dropzone`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focus the clickable zone or its separate trigger. |
| Enter | Open the file picker. |
| Space | Open the file picker without scrolling. |
| Escape | Hide the full-screen overlay. |

Tokens: border, background, foreground, primary, destructive, destructive-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Dropzone, DropzoneAccept, DropzoneIdle, DropzoneReject, DropzoneCaption } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function DropzoneDefault() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  return (
    <Dropzone accept=".csv,text/csv" maxSize={25_000_000}>
      <DropzoneIdle>{t('dropzone.label')}</DropzoneIdle>
      <DropzoneAccept>{t('dropzone.label')}</DropzoneAccept>
      <DropzoneReject>{t('dropzone.reject')}</DropzoneReject>
      <DropzoneCaption />
    </Dropzone>
  );
}
```

### EditableText (`editable-text`)

Inline editing for names and titles. value/defaultValue and editing/defaultEditing support controlled or uncontrolled use; onEditingChange requests mode changes, and a controlled value is updated by the owner in onSave. label names the field. activation is click (default), dblclick, or button (static text and a ghost edit icon). The editor inherits surrounding typography. multiline uses an auto-sizing Textarea; maxLength and placeholder pass to the field. trim defaults to true; validate receives the trimmed value and can return an error. onSave accepts void/true, rejects with a string or false, and displays thrown/rejected Error messages. Pending fields stay read-only and show a Spinner. data-editing, data-pending and data-invalid expose state. Disabled prevents activation. submitOnBlur defaults to true, matching table cells, but may save half-typed text when clicking away; set false to cancel instead. Save/cancel restores preview focus, except blur preserves its destination. onCancel runs on Escape or blur cancellation; unchanged values exit without saving. The exported low-level useInlineEdit<T> hook shares draft, start, cancel(after), commit(after), pending, error and busy state with DataTable. It requires value, parse and onSave(next, previous), plus genericError; optional validate, isEqual, focusEditor, onAccepted and onMove adapt parsing, acceptance and focus. focusEditor receives the requested move on save rejection (undefined on parse/validation errors). after is self/next/prev/null; null preserves blur focus. editing/defaultEditing/onEditingChange control mode. LowLevel shows hook composition; use EditableText for standard text editing.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `EditableText` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/EditableText/EditableText.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/input, @base-ui/react/field, @base-ui/react/button`
- ARIA pattern: button + textbox + alert
- Registry dependencies: button, input, spinner, textarea, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add editable-text`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject editable-text`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the preview/editor and surrounding controls; blur saves, or cancels with submitOnBlur=false. |
| Enter | Open the focused preview (including dblclick mode); save a changed single-line value. |
| Space | Open a click preview or the edit icon button. |
| Escape | Cancel editing and restore preview focus. |
| Enter (multiline) | Insert a newline. |
| Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter | Save a multiline value. |

Tokens: secondary, foreground, destructive-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { EditableText } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function Controlled() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(t('editableText.example.supportAgent'));
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  return (
    <EditableText
      value={value}
      editing={editing}
      onEditingChange={setEditing}
      label={t('editableText.example.agentName')}
      onSave={(next) => setValue(next)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Field (`field`)

Accessible form field scaffolding: Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError and FieldItem wire ids and aria-describedby for any kit control; Fieldset and FieldsetLegend group related fields under one name.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Field` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Field/Field.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/field, @base-ui/react/fieldset`
- ARIA pattern: form field (label + description + error), fieldset/legend
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add field`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject field`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Click on label | Moves focus to the field control |
| Tab | Moves focus to the control; its description and error are announced via aria-describedby |

Tokens: foreground, muted-foreground, destructive-text

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Input } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const isWorkEmail = (v: string) => /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v);

export default function FieldValidation() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('member@example');
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(true);
  const emailInvalid = submitted && !isWorkEmail(email);
  return (
    <form
      noValidate
      className="grid max-w-md gap-5"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSubmitted(true);
      }}
    >
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Project name</FieldLabel>
        <Input defaultValue="billing-dashboard" />
        <FieldDescription>Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid={emailInvalid}>
        <FieldLabel required>Work email</FieldLabel>
        <Input type="email" required value={email} onValueChange={setEmail} />
        <FieldError match={emailInvalid}>Enter a valid work email.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Role</FieldLabel>
        <Input defaultValue="Owner" />
        <FieldDescription>Only an admin can change your role.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <div>
        <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### Input (`input`)

Single-line text input in two sizes (sm, md) with optional leading/trailing icons and addons (prefixes, units, keyboard hints, icon buttons). Invalid, disabled and read-only states; works inside Field. Opt-in `clearable` adds a labelled reset button; `clearOnEscape` consumes Escape only while the editable input has text. `onClear` runs after the value change and `clearLabel` overrides the localized name. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Input` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Input/Input.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/input`
- ARIA pattern: textbox
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add input`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject input`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | With clearOnEscape and non-empty editable text: clears and stops propagation; otherwise propagates |
| Tab | Moves focus into the input; trailing addon buttons follow in tab order |
| Click on label | Inside a Field, focuses the input |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, destructive, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Search, Zap } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Input, InputKbd } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function InputAddons() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Input leadingIcon={Search} placeholder="Search projects…" aria-label="Search projects" />
      <Input leadingIcon={Zap} trailingAddon={<InputKbd>⌘K</InputKbd>} placeholder="Go to…" aria-label="Go to" />
      <Input leadingAddon="app.example.com/" defaultValue="billing" aria-label="Workspace URL" />
      <Input trailingAddon="req/s" defaultValue="2000" inputMode="numeric" aria-label="Rate limit" />
      <Input
        className="pe-1.5 sm:col-span-2"
        leadingIcon={Lock}
        type={show ? 'text' : 'password'}
        defaultValue="sk-live-example-token"
        aria-label="API token"
        trailingAddon={
          <IconButton
            size="sm"
            className="size-7"
            icon={show ? EyeOff : Eye}
            label={show ? 'Hide token' : 'Show token'}
            onClick={() => setShow((v) => !v)}
          />
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### KeyValueEditor (`key-value-editor`)

Editable list of key/value rows (environment variables, headers, labels): add and remove rows (no reordering), per-row validation (required key, key pattern, duplicate keys, optional required value and a custom `validate`), secret rows whose values are masked with a reveal toggle, bulk paste of `.env` text (comments ignored, existing keys updated) and "Copy as .env". Controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled. `parseEnv`, `serializeEnv`, `validateKeyValueRows` and `createKeyValueRow` are exported.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `KeyValueEditor` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/KeyValueEditor/KeyValueEditor.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/input`
- ARIA pattern: group of textboxes + toggle buttons
- Registry dependencies: button, copy-button, input, live-announcer, password-input, textarea, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add key-value-editor`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject key-value-editor`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through each row: key, value, secret toggle, remove; then Add, Paste .env and Copy as .env |
| Enter / Space | On Add variable: appends a row and focuses its key |
| Enter / Space | On Remove: deletes the row, announces it and focuses the next row (or Add) |
| Enter / Space | On the secret toggle: masks or unmasks the value (aria-pressed) |
| Ctrl / ⌘ + V | In a key field, multi-line KEY=value text is imported as rows |

Tokens: background, border, card, foreground, muted-foreground, secondary, destructive, destructive-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { createKeyValueRow, type KeyValueRow } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { KeyValueEditor } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const initial: KeyValueRow[] = [
  createKeyValueRow('API_URL', 'https://api.example.com'),
  createKeyValueRow('LOG_LEVEL', 'info'),
  createKeyValueRow('DATABASE_PASSWORD', 'change-me-in-production', true),
];

/** Controlled: the parent keeps the rows and the validity (e.g. to disable Save). */
export default function KeyValueEditorEnv() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState(initial);
  const [valid, setValid] = useState(true);
  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-3">
      <KeyValueEditor
        aria-label="Environment variables"
        value={rows}
        onChange={setRows}
        onValidityChange={(ok) => setValid(ok)}
      />
      <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted-foreground">
        {rows.filter((r) => r.key).length} variables · {valid ? 'ready to save' : 'fix the highlighted rows to save'}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### ListInput (`list-input`)

Repeatable key/value rows for environment variables, headers or labels: add, remove and reorder (buttons or Alt+Arrow), paste `KEY=value` lines to bulk-add, per-row validation with duplicate-key detection, optional masked values with a reveal toggle. Changes are announced. Use ListInput for standalone pairs without a form library; use FieldArray from @gntik-ai/ui/forms for arbitrary object fields managed by react-hook-form. Built-in labels follow I18nProvider (en/es); caller overrides take precedence. See the TransferList catalog defaults example for a live Spanish preview of this component.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `ListInput` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/ListInput/ListInput.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: list of labelled text field pairs
- Registry dependencies: button, input, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add list-input`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject list-input`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through key, value, reveal, move and remove controls row by row |
| Enter (key field) | Moves to the row value |
| Enter (last value) | Adds a row and focuses its key |
| Alt+ArrowUp / Alt+ArrowDown | Moves the row up / down, keeping focus in the same field |
| Paste | Multi-line or KEY=value text is split into rows |
| Enter / Space on a remove button | Removes the row and focuses the next one |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, destructive, destructive-text, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { ListInput } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const SECRET = /(SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|KEY)$/;

export default function ListInputEnvVars() {
  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-2">
      <h3 className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground">Environment variables</h3>
      <ListInput
        label="Environment variables"
        defaultValue={[
          { key: 'NODE_ENV', value: 'production' },
          { key: 'DATABASE_URL', value: 'postgres://db.internal:5432/app' },
          { key: 'STRIPE_SECRET', value: 'sk_live_51H8x' },
        ]}
        secret={(row) => SECRET.test(row.key)}
        validate={(row) => ({
          key: /^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$/.test(row.key) ? null : 'Use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.',
          value: row.value ? null : 'A value is required.',
        })}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### ModelPicker (`model-picker`)

Choose the model (and provider) for a conversation: options grouped by provider with a description, capability badges (vision, tools, reasoning, files, web, audio) and the context size; unavailable models stay listed, disabled, with the reason. `compact` gives a small borderless trigger for the ChatComposer toolbar. Controlled (`value` + `onValueChange`).

- Package: `@gntik-ai/chat` · export `ModelPicker` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/chat/src/ModelPicker/ModelPicker.doc.ts
- Primitive: `Select`
- ARIA pattern: select-only combobox
- Install: `gntik-ui add model-picker`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject model-picker`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown | On the trigger: opens the list |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Moves between models; a disabled one can be highlighted (its reason is read) but not selected |
| Type a character | Jumps to the model whose name starts with it |
| Enter | Selects the highlighted model and closes |
| Escape | Closes without changing; focus returns to the trigger |

Tokens: background, popover, border, secondary, primary, primary-text, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ModelPicker } from '@gntik-ai/chat';
import { DEMO_MODELS } from '@gntik-ai/chat';

export default function ModelPickerProviders() {
  const [model, setModel] = useState<string | null>('balanced');
  const [compactModel, setCompactModel] = useState<string | null>('swift');
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4">
      <ModelPicker models={DEMO_MODELS} value={model} onValueChange={setModel} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-1.5">
        <span className="ps-1.5 text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">Composer toolbar</span>
        <ModelPicker compact models={DEMO_MODELS} value={compactModel} onValueChange={setCompactModel} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### MultiSelect (`multi-select`)

Searchable multi-select: selected options as removable chips (extra ones collapse into "+N"), a "Select all" row, a clear button and rows with descriptions. Built on Base UI Combobox (multiple) with the Combobox house styles; works inside Field. Optional async options (`loadOptions`, debounced and abortable, with loading/error states) and creatable rows (`onCreate`). Opt-in virtualized renders only visible rows, with itemHeight, estimatedItemHeight (default 32) and overscan (default 4). Select all applies to the full enabled data set. Keyboard highlights stay mounted; find-in-page and browse mode reach rendered rows only. Built-in labels follow I18nProvider (en/es); caller overrides take precedence. See the TransferList catalog defaults example for a live Spanish preview of this component. Read-only mode preserves the selection and prevents edits. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries. MultiSelectOption.group adds headings in first-seen order after ungrouped options; filtering removes empty groups. ComboboxGroup, ComboboxGroupLabel and ComboboxCollection provide the shared grouped presentation. Select all selects or clears enabled options across every group. Grouped options retain full rendering even with virtualized. See MultiSelectGrouped for mixed groups, a disabled option and creation.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `MultiSelect` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/MultiSelect/MultiSelect.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/combobox`
- ARIA pattern: combobox (multi-select listbox)
- Registry dependencies: combobox, spinner, ui-utils, virtual-list
- Install: `gntik-ui add multi-select`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject multi-select`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Home / End, PageUp / PageDown | Virtualized: jumps to the first / last option or moves by a viewport |
| Type a character | Opens the popup and filters the options |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Moves the highlight between options |
| Enter | Toggles the highlighted option (on "Select all": selects or clears every option) |
| Escape | Closes the popup, keeping focus in the input |
| Backspace | On an empty input, removes the last chip |
| Enter on “Create …” / “Retry” | Creates and selects an option from the typed text / loads the options again after an error |

Tokens: background, border, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-text, secondary, muted-foreground, destructive, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { matchText } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect, type MultiSelectOption } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const TOPICS: MultiSelectOption[] = [
  { value: 'billing', label: 'billing', description: '128 issues' },
  { value: 'onboarding', label: 'onboarding', description: '42 issues' },
  { value: 'performance', label: 'performance', description: '77 issues' },
  { value: 'search', label: 'search', description: '19 issues' },
  { value: 'security', label: 'security', description: '35 issues' },
];

/** Stands in for `fetch('/api/topics?q=…', { signal })`. */
function searchTopics(
  query: string,
  { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal },
  locale?: string,
): Promise<MultiSelectOption[]> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(TOPICS.filter((t) => matchText(t.label, query, { locale }))), 250);
    signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
    });
  });
}

export default function MultiSelectAsync() {
  const { locale } = useI18n();
  const loadOptions = useCallback(
    (query: string, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => searchTopics(query, context, locale),
    [locale],
  );
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string[]>([]);
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <MultiSelect
        label="Topics"
        placeholder="Search or create topics…"
        options={[]}
        value={value}
        onValueChange={setValue}
        loadOptions={loadOptions}
        onCreate={(input) => {
          const created = { value: input.toLowerCase(), label: input.toLowerCase(), description: 'New topic' };
          TOPICS.push(created);
          return created;
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### NumberInput (`number-input`)

Numeric input with − / + steppers, a unit suffix, min/max/step clamping, locale formatting and an optional scrub label (drag to change). Sizes sm and md like Input; invalid, disabled and read-only states; works inside Field. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `NumberInput` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/NumberInput/NumberInput.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/number-field`
- ARIA pattern: spinbutton-like textbox (number field)
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add number-input`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject number-input`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Increments / decrements by step (Shift: largeStep, Alt: smallStep) |
| PageUp / PageDown | Increments / decrements by largeStep |
| Home / End | Sets the value to min / max (when defined) |
| Click on label | Inside a Field, focuses the input |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, destructive, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { NumberInput } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function NumberInputBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Replicas</FieldLabel>
        <NumberInput defaultValue={3} min={1} max={20} />
        <FieldDescription>Between 1 and 20 instances per region.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Storage (GB)</FieldLabel>
        <NumberInput defaultValue={100} min={10} max={2000} step={10} largeStep={100} unit="GB" />
        <FieldDescription>Steps of 10 GB; PageUp / PageDown jump by 100.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Monthly budget</FieldLabel>
        <NumberInput
          defaultValue={1250}
          min={0}
          step={50}
          locale="en-US"
          format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }}
        />
      </Field>
      <NumberInput scrubLabel="Opacity (%)" defaultValue={80} min={0} max={100} unit="%" size="sm" hideSteppers />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### OtpInput (`otp-input`)

One-time / verification code input: 4–8 character boxes, numeric or alphanumeric, optional group separator. Typing auto-advances, paste fills every slot, onComplete fires when full; invalid and disabled states; works inside Field.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `OtpInput` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/OtpInput/OtpInput.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/otp-field`
- ARIA pattern: group of single-character textboxes
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add otp-input`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject otp-input`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Type a character | Fills the slot and moves to the next one |
| Backspace | Clears the slot, or the previous one when empty, and moves back |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | Moves between slots |
| Paste (⌘V / Ctrl+V) | Fills the slots from the clipboard, dropping invalid characters |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, destructive, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { OtpInput } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

/** Verification flow: "123456" is the valid demo code. */
export default function OtpInputBasic() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'ok' | 'error'>('idle');
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <Field invalid={status === 'error'}>
        <FieldLabel>Verification code</FieldLabel>
        <OtpInput
          groupSize={3}
          onValueChange={() => setStatus('idle')}
          onComplete={(code) => setStatus(code === '123456' ? 'ok' : 'error')}
        />
        {status === 'ok' ? (
          <p role="status" className="text-[12px] text-success-text">
            Code verified. Your device is trusted.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <FieldDescription>Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your authenticator app.</FieldDescription>
        )}
        <FieldError match={status === 'error'}>That code is not valid. Try again.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Invite code</FieldLabel>
        <OtpInput length={8} type="alphanumeric" size="sm" groupSize={4} defaultValue="K7Q2" />
        <FieldDescription>Letters and numbers, from the workspace invitation email.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### PasswordInput (`password-input`)

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, secondary, destructive, destructive-text, warning, warning-text, success, success-text, focus-ring

### PeriodPicker (`period-picker`)

Whole ISO weeks, months, calendar quarters or years, single or range. PeriodPicker is a field and Base UI popover; PeriodCalendar is inline. Single values are the first day of a whole period at local midnight, not a single-day selection. Ranges include the last day of the final period. Weeks always run Monday–Sunday and use the ISO week-year, regardless of locale. Month names use Intl; quarter/week labels and presets use the en/es i18n catalogs. Form values: YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn, YYYY or YYYY-Www; ranges submit <name>-start and <name>-end. Defaults are this and last complete period; presets=[] hides them. Min/max compare period overlap; disabled periods remain focusable. Range fields apply on the second pick; Escape discards an unfinished range. Calendar and DatePicker remain day-only.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `PeriodPicker` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/PeriodPicker/PeriodPicker.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/popover + internal Calendar period grids`
- ARIA pattern: combobox with a dialog popup; inline grid with roving tabindex
- Registry dependencies: calendar, date-picker, popover, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add period-picker`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject period-picker`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space (field) | Opens the popup and focuses the selected period or today |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | One tab stop inside each grid; other controls and presets remain in the tab order |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | Moves one cell, crossing year/page boundaries; mirrored in RTL |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Moves one row: three months/years, four quarters, or seven days |
| Home / End | Moves to the first/last cell of the row (ISO Monday/Sunday for weeks) |
| PageUp / PageDown | Months/quarters: same period in the previous/next year; years: 12-year page; weeks: month (Shift: year) |
| Enter / Space (grid) | Selects the period (range: start then end); aria-disabled cells cannot be selected |
| Enter / Space (title) | Drills up: weeks → months → years; picking a coarser cell returns with focus restored |
| Enter / Space (previous/next) | Moves one visible page: month for weeks, year for months/quarters, 12 years for years |
| Escape | Closes the popup and returns focus to the field without applying an unfinished range |

Tokens: background, foreground, muted-foreground, border, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, popover, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { PeriodPicker } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function BillingMonth() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  return (
    <Field className="max-w-xs">
      <FieldLabel>{t('periodPicker.billingMonth')}</FieldLabel>
      <PeriodPicker
        granularity="month"
        name="billing-month"
        today={new Date(2026, 9, 17)}
        defaultValue={new Date(2026, 2, 1)}
      />
      <FieldDescription>{t('periodPicker.wholePeriodDescription')}</FieldDescription>
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### PermissionMatrix (`permission-matrix`)

Roles (columns) × permissions (rows grouped in sections) editor. Cells are tri-state — allowed, denied, inherited — shown with an icon and a word, never colour alone; inherited cells are dashed and can say what they resolve to. Read-only columns (e.g. owner) and per-cell disabled reasons in a tooltip; controlled `value` + `onChange`; one tab stop with grid arrow-key navigation.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `PermissionMatrix` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/PermissionMatrix/PermissionMatrix.doc.ts
- Primitive: `native table (role="grid") + @base-ui/react/tooltip`
- ARIA pattern: data grid (roving tabindex)
- Registry dependencies: tooltip, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add permission-matrix`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject permission-matrix`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Enters and leaves the grid (one tab stop, on the last focused cell) |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Moves between cells (left/right mirror in RTL); section headings are skipped |
| Home / End | First / last cell of the row |
| Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End | First / last cell of the grid |
| PageUp / PageDown | First / last cell of the column |
| Enter / Space | Cycles the cell: allowed → denied → inherited |
| A / D / I | Sets the cell to allowed / denied / inherited |

Tokens: card, border, secondary, foreground, muted-foreground, success, success-chip-text, destructive, destructive-chip-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  PermissionMatrix,
  type PermissionMatrixValue,
  type PermissionRole,
  type PermissionSection,
} from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const roles: PermissionRole[] = [
  { id: 'owner', label: 'Owner', readOnly: true, readOnlyReason: 'Owners always have every permission.' },
  { id: 'admin', label: 'Admin' },
  { id: 'member', label: 'Member' },
  { id: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer', description: 'Inherits from Member' },
];

const sections: PermissionSection[] = [
  {
    id: 'projects',
    label: 'Projects',
    permissions: [
      { id: 'projects.read', label: 'View projects' },
      { id: 'projects.write', label: 'Edit projects', description: 'Rename, archive and change settings' },
      { id: 'projects.delete', label: 'Delete projects' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'billing',
    label: 'Billing',
    permissions: [
      { id: 'billing.read', label: 'View invoices' },
      { id: 'billing.manage', label: 'Manage payment methods' },
    ],
  },
];

const all = (state: 'allowed' | 'denied') =>
  Object.fromEntries(sections.flatMap((s) => s.permissions.map((p) => [p.id, state])));

const initial: PermissionMatrixValue = {
  owner: all('allowed'),
  admin: {
    'projects.read': 'allowed',
    'projects.write': 'allowed',
    'projects.delete': 'allowed',
    'billing.read': 'allowed',
    'billing.manage': 'denied',
  },
  member: {
    'projects.read': 'allowed',
    'projects.write': 'allowed',
    'projects.delete': 'denied',
    'billing.read': 'denied',
    'billing.manage': 'denied',
  },
  viewer: { 'projects.write': 'denied' },
};

export default function PermissionMatrixBasic() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial);
  return (
    <PermissionMatrix
      caption="Workspace roles"
      roles={roles}
      sections={sections}
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
      resolveInherited={(roleId, permissionId) =>
        roleId === 'viewer' ? (value.member?.[permissionId] === 'denied' ? 'denied' : 'allowed') : undefined
      }
      getDisabledReason={(roleId, permissionId) =>
        roleId === 'member' && permissionId === 'billing.manage' ? 'Only admins can manage payment methods.' : undefined
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### PowerSearch (`power-search`)

Structured filter input: pick a field, an operator and a value from suggestions (or type `status=failed`, `cost>100`), add free text, and edit committed terms from the keyboard. Emits a typed query AST (`{ type: "and", terms }`) with parse / format / match helpers; fields, operators and values are props.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `PowerSearch` · group Forms · status experimental
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/PowerSearch/PowerSearch.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/combobox`
- ARIA pattern: combobox + list of editable filter terms
- Registry dependencies: select, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add power-search`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject power-search`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Opens the suggestions and moves the highlight |
| Enter | Picks the highlighted suggestion; otherwise commits the typed value or free text (empty input: submit) |
| field=value / field:value | Typed shortcut: jumps straight to the value step |
| Backspace (empty input) | Steps back: operator → field → edits the last term |
| ArrowLeft (input start) | Moves focus to the last term |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / Home / End (on a term) | Moves between terms; past the last returns to the input |
| Enter / Space (on a term) | Pulls the term back into the input to edit it |
| Delete / Backspace (on a term) | Removes the term |
| Escape | Closes the suggestions; again clears the term being built |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, primary-text, secondary, popover, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { PowerSearch } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { formatPowerSearch, matchPowerSearch, parsePowerSearch, type PowerSearchQuery } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { deploymentFields, deployments, type DeploymentField } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function PowerSearchDeployments() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState<PowerSearchQuery<DeploymentField>>(() =>
    parsePowerSearch('status=failed', deploymentFields),
  );
  const rows = deployments.filter((d) => matchPowerSearch(query, d));
  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-3">
      <PowerSearch aria-label="Filter deployments" fields={deploymentFields} value={query} onValueChange={setQuery} />
      <p className="font-mono text-[11.5px] text-muted-foreground">{formatPowerSearch(query) || 'No filters'}</p>
      <ul
        aria-label="Matching deployments"
        className="divide-y divide-border rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-[12.5px]"
      >
        {rows.map((d) => (
          <li key={d.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2">
            <span className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">{d.id}</span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-foreground">{d.project}</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">{d.region}</span>
            <span className="w-20 text-end">{d.status}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
        {rows.length === 0 && <li className="px-3 py-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">No deployments match.</li>}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### QueryBuilder (`query-builder`)

Visual filter editor: nested AND/OR groups of field / operator / value conditions. Typed fields (text, number, enum, date, boolean) offer their operators and value editor (Input, NumberInput, Select / MultiSelect, DatePicker, ranges for "between"); add and remove conditions and groups up to `maxDepth`. The value is a serialisable tree; `queryToString(tree)` makes it human-readable and `evaluateQuery(tree, record)` tests a record. Inverted numeric or date "between" ranges show an inline error and are ignored by evaluation. Before sending a query to a backend, check each condition with `isConditionComplete` and `isConditionValid`; validation preserves the entered values.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `QueryBuilder` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/QueryBuilder/QueryBuilder.doc.ts
- Primitive: `Select, MultiSelect, Input, NumberInput, DatePicker, ToggleGroup, Button`
- ARIA pattern: nested groups of form controls
- Registry dependencies: button, calendar, date-picker, input, multi-select, number-input, select, toggle-group, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add query-builder`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject query-builder`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves through each condition's field, operator, value and remove button, then the group's buttons |
| Enter / Space | On Add condition / Add group: adds it and focuses its first field; on a remove button: removes it and focuses Add condition |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | In a group's AND / OR switch: moves between the options (Enter / Space picks) |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown | On a field, operator or enum value: opens its list (see Select) |

Tokens: card, secondary, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, focus-ring, destructive-text

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { QueryBuilder } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { deploymentFields, deploymentQuery } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function QueryBuilderBasic() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(deploymentQuery);
  return (
    <QueryBuilder
      aria-label="Deployment filter"
      fields={deploymentFields}
      value={query}
      onChange={setQuery}
      locale="en-US"
      showPreview
      className="max-w-4xl"
    />
  );
}
```

### RadioGroup (`radio-group`)

Single choice from a short list. RadioGroup + Radio with optional label, description and trailing content per option, in plain, list (bordered rows) and card variants. An explicit aria-label takes precedence over the visible label; keep both consistent for WCAG 2.5.3 (label in name).

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `RadioGroup` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/RadioGroup/RadioGroup.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/radio-group, @base-ui/react/radio`
- ARIA pattern: radio group
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add radio-group`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject radio-group`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Enters the group once, on the selected radio (or the first one); Tab again leaves the group |
| Arrow Down / Arrow Right | Moves to the next radio and selects it (wraps) |
| Arrow Up / Arrow Left | Moves to the previous radio and selects it (wraps) |
| Space | Selects the focused radio if it is not already selected |

Tokens: background, border, primary, primary-foreground, foreground, muted-foreground, destructive, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Fieldset, FieldsetLegend } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const PLANS = [
  { value: 'shared', label: 'Shared', description: 'Shared CPU · cold starts', price: 'Free' },
  { value: 'dedicated', label: 'Dedicated', description: '2 vCPU · always warm', price: '$80/mo' },
  {
    value: 'isolated',
    label: 'Isolated',
    description: 'Private network · no neighbours',
    price: '$240/mo',
    disabled: true,
  },
];

export default function RadioGroupCards() {
  return (
    <Fieldset className="max-w-lg" render={<RadioGroup variant="card" defaultValue="dedicated" name="plan" />}>
      <FieldsetLegend>Deployment plan</FieldsetLegend>
      {PLANS.map((p) => (
        <Radio
          key={p.value}
          value={p.value}
          label={p.label}
          description={p.description}
          trailing={p.price}
          disabled={p.disabled}
        />
      ))}
    </Fieldset>
  );
}
```

### ScheduleInput (`schedule-input`)

Cron schedule editor: presets (hourly at minute, daily at, weekly on days at, monthly on day at) that write a 5-field cron expression, plus a raw cron field (*, lists, ranges, steps, names, macros) with validation and an error message, a plain-language summary ("Every weekday at 09:00") and the next runs in a time zone. Pure helpers: parseCron, describeCron, nextRuns. Display timeZone defaults to I18nProvider (system when unset); use the same zone on server and client. The TimeZone example shows the provider default and UTC overrides

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `ScheduleInput` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/ScheduleInput/ScheduleInput.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/toggle-group + Field, Input, NumberInput, TimePicker`
- ARIA pattern: group of form controls (segmented control, textbox, spinbuttons)
- Registry dependencies: calendar, field, input, number-input, time-picker, toggle-group, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add schedule-input`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject schedule-input`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves between the frequency tabs, the preset fields and the cron field |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | In the frequency or weekday group: moves between options |
| Enter / Space | Picks the focused frequency, or toggles the focused weekday |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | In the minute, day or time fields: steps the value |
| Type in the cron field | Re-validates, updates the summary and the next runs, and selects the preset that fits |

Tokens: background, border, card, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, secondary, destructive-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ScheduleInput } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const now = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 5, 15, 7, 30));

export default function ScheduleInputBasic() {
  const [cron, setCron] = useState('0 9 * * 1-5');
  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-xl flex-col gap-6">
      <ScheduleInput
        aria-label="Report schedule"
        value={cron}
        onValueChange={setCron}
        timeZone="Europe/Madrid"
        locale="en-US"
        now={now}
        name="schedule"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### SearchableSelect (`searchable-select`)

A button-triggered picker with search inside the popup. Options have value, label, description, icon, keywords and disabled; groups have label and options. getOptionKey defaults to String(value); supply a stable key for object values. Single value/defaultValue/onValueChange use Value | null; multiple uses Value[]. name, required, disabled and readOnly use the Combobox form contract; an empty selection submits nothing. label names the field and list; without it supply aria-label. The default trigger shows the selected icon and label or a localized count. trigger renders a kit Button through the Base UI render prop. size is auto (density), sm, md or lg. placeholder, searchPlaceholder and emptyText override catalog defaults. Search matches labels, descriptions and keywords without case or accent differences; filter replaces matching and onSearchChange reports queries. actions always follow options and run onSelect without entering selection or form values. Opt-in virtualized windows flat lists using the existing Combobox root; itemHeight and overscan configure the window. Groups retain full rendering. Mounted options expose aria-posinset/aria-setsize and the keyboard highlight stays rendered and scrolled into view. Browser find and screen-reader browse mode reach mounted options only. See the field example for the which-picker table: Select for short lists; Combobox for typed input; MultiSelect for chips in a field; SearchableSelect for field, button or toolbar triggers with popup search. The examples cover field and toolbar triggers, grouped regions, 5,000 options, and action rows. Built-in strings follow I18nProvider (en/es).

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `SearchableSelect` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/SearchableSelect/SearchableSelect.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/combobox`
- ARIA pattern: button-triggered combobox + popup search + listbox
- Registry dependencies: combobox, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add searchable-select`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject searchable-select`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown on trigger | Opens the popup and focuses its search input |
| Type a character | Filters the options, hides empty groups and highlights the first match |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Moves the highlight while focus stays in the search input |
| Enter | Single: selects and closes; multiple: toggles and keeps the query and popup |
| Escape | Closes without changing the value and returns focus to the trigger |
| Enter on an action | Runs its callback once, closes and returns focus without changing the value |
| Home / End / PageUp / PageDown | Virtualized: moves to the first/last option or by one viewport |

Tokens: background, foreground, border, popover, popover-foreground, primary-text, secondary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Settings } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { SearchableSelect } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { useRegions } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function SearchableSelectActions() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [managed, setManaged] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div data-example="searchable-select-actions" className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-2">
      <SearchableSelect
        options={useRegions()}
        label={t('searchableSelect.examples.region')}
        emptyText={t('searchableSelect.examples.customEmpty')}
        searchPlaceholder={t('common.searchPlaceholder')}
        placeholder={t('common.selectPlaceholder')}
        actions={[
          {
            id: 'manage',
            label: t('searchableSelect.examples.manage'),
            icon: Settings,
            onSelect: () => setManaged(true),
          },
        ]}
      />
      <p role="status" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {managed ? t('searchableSelect.examples.managed') : ''}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### SecretField (`secret-field`)

A secret value (API key, token, connection string) on Input: masked by default (fixed-length mask, optional visible prefix/suffix), a reveal toggle (aria-pressed), a CopyButton that copies the real value and announces it, an optional Rotate action behind an AlertDialog confirmation, and optional created / last-used meta. Optional showLabel, hideLabel, copyLabel and copiedAnnouncement override i18n defaults. Read-only by default (`editable` turns it into a password field). While masked and read-only the secret is not in the DOM, and it is never put in a title or tooltip. `maskSecret` is exported too.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `SecretField` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/SecretField/SecretField.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/input`
- ARIA pattern: read-only textbox + toggle button + button
- Registry dependencies: alert-dialog, button, copy-button, input, live-announcer, timestamp, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add secret-field`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject secret-field`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through the field, the reveal toggle, Copy and Rotate |
| Enter / Space | On the reveal toggle: shows or hides the value (aria-pressed) |
| Enter / Space | On Copy: copies the secret and announces "Secret copied to clipboard" |
| Enter / Space | On Rotate: opens the confirmation (focus moves into it) |
| Escape | Closes the confirmation without rotating; focus returns to Rotate |

Tokens: background, border, secondary, foreground, muted-foreground, primary-text, warning, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { SecretField } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const DAY = 24 * 3600 * 1000;

export default function SecretFieldBasic() {
  const [now] = useState(() => Date.now());
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>API key</FieldLabel>
        <SecretField
          value="sk_live_51Hc8xQ2eZvKYlo2C9a7d"
          visiblePrefix={8}
          visibleSuffix={4}
          createdAt={now - 12 * DAY}
          lastUsedAt={now - 2 * 3600 * 1000}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Webhook signing secret</FieldLabel>
        <SecretField value="whsec_3f9a0c1b7e2d4f6a8b0c" size="sm" lastUsedAt={null} />
        <FieldDescription>Verify the signature header with this value.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Select (`select`)

Pick one value from a popup list using compound parts or SimpleSelect. SimpleSelect exposes ref and triggerRef aliases for its trigger button. Compound parts (Select, SelectLabel, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectGroup, SelectGroupLabel, SelectSeparator) plus a one-line SimpleSelect. Three trigger sizes; rich rows (avatar, status dot) via item children. SimpleSelect can load its options on first open (`loadOptions(query, { signal })`) with announced loading, empty and error states. Creatable lives in Combobox / MultiSelect (a select has no text input). SimpleSelect `clearable` adds a sibling reset button; Delete or Backspace on its trigger clears to null and retains focus. `onClear` runs after the value change; `clearLabel` overrides the localized name. For long lists, use Combobox with virtualized and a flat items array (see ComboboxVirtualized); Select requires its options to stay mounted for typeahead. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Select` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Select/Select.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/select`
- ARIA pattern: select-only combobox + listbox
- Registry dependencies: combobox, spinner, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add select`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject select`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Delete / Backspace | With clearable on a non-empty editable trigger: clears and keeps focus |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown | On the trigger: opens the popup |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Moves the highlight between options |
| Enter | Selects the highlighted option and closes the popup |
| Escape | Closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger |
| Type a character | Typeahead: highlights the next option starting with it |
| Escape, then Enter / ArrowDown | After a failed async load: closing and reopening the popup retries |

Tokens: background, border, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-text, secondary, muted-foreground, ring, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SimpleSelect, type SimpleSelectItem } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

/** Stands in for `fetch('/api/clusters', { signal })`: the list loads the first time the popup opens. */
function loadClusters(_query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }): Promise<SimpleSelectItem[]> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(
      () =>
        resolve([
          { value: 'prod-eu', label: 'prod-eu · 12 nodes' },
          { value: 'prod-us', label: 'prod-us · 9 nodes' },
          { value: 'staging', label: 'staging · 3 nodes' },
        ]),
      400,
    );
    signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
    });
  });
}

export default function SelectAsync() {
  const [cluster, setCluster] = useState<string | null>('prod-eu');
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <SimpleSelect
        label="Target cluster"
        // The selected value's label is known up front; the rest loads on open.
        items={[{ value: 'prod-eu', label: 'prod-eu · 12 nodes' }]}
        loadOptions={loadClusters}
        value={cluster}
        onValueChange={setCluster}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Slider (`slider`)

Pick a number or a range on a track. Single or range thumbs (one per value), optional visible label and live value readout, two sizes, works inside Field and Form.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Slider` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Slider/Slider.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/slider`
- ARIA pattern: slider (multi-thumb for ranges)
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add slider`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject slider`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| ArrowRight / ArrowUp | Increases the focused thumb by one step |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowDown | Decreases the focused thumb by one step |
| PageUp / PageDown | Increases / decreases by the large step |
| Home / End | Moves the focused thumb to the minimum / maximum |
| Tab | Moves focus between thumbs |

Tokens: primary, secondary, background, foreground, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function SliderRange() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-7">
      <Slider
        label="Autoscaling bounds"
        showValue
        min={1}
        max={20}
        defaultValue={[2, 8]}
        minStepsBetweenValues={1}
        thumbLabels={['Minimum instances', 'Maximum instances']}
      />
      <Slider
        label="Monthly budget"
        showValue
        min={0}
        max={5000}
        step={100}
        largeStep={500}
        defaultValue={[500, 2000]}
        format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }}
        thumbLabels={['Minimum budget', 'Maximum budget']}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Switch (`switch`)

On/off setting that applies immediately. Three sizes, optional inline label, works inside Field and Form. An explicit aria-label takes precedence over the visible label; keep both consistent for WCAG 2.5.3 (label in name).

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |

| Enter | Toggles the switch |
| Tab | Moves focus to and from the switch |

Tokens: primary, secondary, background, focus-ring

### Textarea (`textarea`)

Multi-line text input in two sizes, with optional CSS autosize (field-sizing: content) and vertical resize. Renders through Base UI Field.Control, so it works inside Field. Opt-in `clearable` reserves space for a reset button and returns focus to the textarea. `onClear` runs after the value change; `clearLabel` overrides the localized name. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Textarea` · group Forms · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Textarea/Textarea.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/field (Field.Control)`
- ARIA pattern: textbox (multi-line)
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add textarea`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject textarea`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus into and out of the textarea |
| Enter | Inserts a new line (does not submit the form) |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, destructive, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx

          <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] leading-6 text-muted-foreground">Grows with its content.</p>
        </div>

          <Textarea
            autosize
            defaultValue="Customer-facing billing dashboard. Owns invoices, payment methods and usage reports for every workspace."
            placeholder="Describe what this project does…"
          />
```
