```tsx
            <Info size={13} aria-hidden className="shrink-0" />
            Versioned on every save; you can revert from the history.
          </FieldDescription>
        </div>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### TimePicker (`time-picker`)

Accessible time field with a ref to its hours segment: hour and minute spinbutton segments, optional seconds, a 12-hour clock with AM/PM by locale or prop, minute step, min/max validation, controlled or uncontrolled (`"HH:mm"` strings). Digits type and auto-advance; arrows spin. Works inside Field; DatePicker `withTime` and DateTimeRangePicker reuse it. Opt-in `clearable` resets every segment to its placeholder and focuses hours. `onClear` runs after emitting null; `clearLabel` overrides the localized button name. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `TimePicker` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/TimePicker/TimePicker.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/field (control) + spinbutton segments`
- ARIA pattern: group of spinbuttons (time field)
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add time-picker`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject time-picker`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves between segments, then out of the field |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Increments / decrements the focused segment (minutes by `step`), wrapping around |
| Home / End | Sets the segment to its minimum / maximum |
| 0–9 | Types into the segment; moves to the next one when it is full |
| A / P | On the AM/PM segment: picks AM or PM |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | Moves to the previous / next segment |
| Backspace / Delete | Clears the segment (the value becomes null) |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, primary-chip-text, secondary, destructive, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { TimePicker } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function TimePickerBasic() {
  const [start, setStart] = useState<string | null>('09:00');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Maintenance window starts</FieldLabel>
        <TimePicker value={start} onValueChange={setStart} hourCycle={24} step={15} name="window-start" />
        <FieldDescription>Arrow keys move in 15-minute steps.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Reminder</FieldLabel>
        <TimePicker defaultValue="17:30" hourCycle={12} locale="en-US" />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Timeout at</FieldLabel>
        <TimePicker defaultValue="00:05:30" withSeconds hourCycle={24} />
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Locked time</FieldLabel>
        <TimePicker defaultValue="12:00" hourCycle={24} disabled />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### TokenInput (`token-input`)

Free-entry chips for emails, labels or hosts: Enter, Tab or a separator commits, pasted lists are split, `validate` marks bad entries as invalid chips, `maxItems` caps the list. Additions and removals are announced; works inside Field. Read-only mode prevents text edits, committing entries and chip removal. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `TokenInput` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/TokenInput/TokenInput.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/field (Field.Control)`
- ARIA pattern: textbox + list of removable entries
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add token-input`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject token-input`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Tab | Commits the typed text as a chip (Tab only when there is text) |
| , / ; | Commits the typed text (configurable separators) |
| Backspace | On an empty input, removes the last chip |
| Paste | Splits the clipboard on separators and new lines into chips |
| Tab to a chip button, Enter | Removes that chip |

Tokens: background, border, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, primary-text, destructive, destructive-text, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { TokenInput } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export default function TokenInputEmails() {
  const [emails, setEmails] = useState(['ana@example.com', 'devops@example', 'li.wei@example.com']);
  const invalid = emails.filter((e) => !EMAIL.test(e)).length;
  return (
    <div className="max-w-lg">
      <Field invalid={invalid > 0}>
        <FieldLabel>Invite members</FieldLabel>
        <TokenInput
          value={emails}
          onValueChange={setEmails}
          transform={(raw) => raw.trim().toLowerCase()}
          validate={(e) => (EMAIL.test(e) ? null : 'Not a valid email address')}
          maxItems={10}
          placeholder="name@company.com"
          name="invites"
          listLabel="Invitees"
        />
        <FieldDescription>
          {invalid > 0
            ? `Fix ${invalid} invalid address${invalid > 1 ? 'es' : ''} before sending.`
            : 'Press Enter or comma to add. Paste a list to add several.'}
        </FieldDescription>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### TransferList (`transfer-list`)

Two lists, available and selected, for picking and ordering a subset (columns, scopes, members): search each side, check several items, move them with the middle buttons, Enter or a double click, and reorder the selected side. Moves are announced. Opt-in virtualized windows both panes with shared row measurement, keeps the active option mounted and preserves full-data bulk actions and keyboard reordering. Find-in-page and screen-reader browse mode reach rendered rows only. Built-in defaults follow I18nProvider (en/es); labels overrides win per key. The catalog defaults example demonstrates the shared component labels, including overlays, lists, navigation and file controls.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `TransferList` · group Forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/TransferList/TransferList.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: two multi-select listboxes (aria-activedescendant) + action buttons
- Registry dependencies: button, input, ui-utils, virtual-list
- Install: `gntik-ui add transfer-list`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject transfer-list`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves between search fields, the two lists and the action buttons |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp, Home / End | Moves the active option in the focused list |
| Space | Checks or unchecks the active option |
| Shift+ArrowDown / Shift+ArrowUp | Moves and checks, extending the selection |
| Ctrl/Cmd+A | Checks (or unchecks) every visible option |
| Enter | Moves the checked options (or the active one) to the other list |
| Alt+ArrowUp / Alt+ArrowDown | Selected list: moves the checked options (or the active one) up / down |

Tokens: card, border, background, foreground, muted-foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { I18nProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { BottomSheet, BottomSheetContent, BottomSheetTrigger } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Carousel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { JsonViewer } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Lightbox } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { ListInput } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { MegaMenu } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { MultiSelect } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { OverflowList } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Thumbnail, ThumbnailList } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Timer } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Tour } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { TreeList } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { VirtualList } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { TransferList } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const items = [
  { value: 'report', label: 'Report' },
  { value: 'notes', label: 'Notes' },
];
const preview =
  'data:image/svg+xml,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 160 120"><circle cx="80" cy="60" r="40" fill-opacity="0.2"/></svg>',
  );

/** Caller content stays English; built-in labels follow the Spanish provider. */
export default function TransferListCatalogDefaults() {
  const [tourOpen, setTourOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mediaOpen, setMediaOpen] = useState(false);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(['report.pdf', 'upload.csv', 'retry.pdf']);
  const [retrying, setRetrying] = useState(false);
  return (
    <I18nProvider locale="es">
      <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-6" data-i18n-catalog>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Spanish defaults, English caller content. Labels and function overrides still take precedence.
        </p>
        <TransferList items={items} />
        <TreeList
          aria-label="Remote files"
          nodes={[{ id: 'remote', label: 'Remote', hasChildren: true }]}
          loadChildren={() => Promise.reject(new Error('Offline example'))}
        />
        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <Timer start={0} end={3725000} status="paused" format="compact" />
          <Timer start={0} end={65000} status="stopped" format="compact" />
        </div>
        <ListInput label="Variables" defaultValue={[{ key: 'REGION', value: 'west' }]} secret />
        <Carousel label="Documents" showDots autoplay={5000}>
          <div>Report</div>
          <div>Notes</div>
        </Carousel>
        <JsonViewer data={{ report: { name: 'Quarterly report', pages: 3 }, tags: ['draft'] }} />
        <VirtualList items={[]} renderItem={() => null} height={80} />
        <MegaMenu items={[{ id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', href: '#overview' }]} />
        <OverflowList items={['Report', 'Notes', 'Archive', 'Draft']} max={1} renderItem={(item) => item} />
        <ThumbnailList aria-label="Files">
          {files.map((name) => (
            <Thumbnail
              key={name}
              name={name}
              progress={name === 'upload.csv' || (name === 'retry.pdf' && retrying) ? 40 : undefined}
              error={name === 'retry.pdf' && !retrying}
              onRemove={() => setFiles((current) => current.filter((file) => file !== name))}
              onRetry={name === 'retry.pdf' ? () => setRetrying(true) : undefined}
            />
          ))}
        </ThumbnailList>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          onClick={() => {
            setFiles(['report.pdf', 'upload.csv', 'retry.pdf']);
            setRetrying(false);
          }}
        >
          Reset files
        </Button>
        <MultiSelect label="Documents" options={items} defaultValue={['report']} />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button onClick={() => setTourOpen(true)}>Start tour</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => setMediaOpen(true)}>View media</Button>
          <BottomSheet>
            <BottomSheetTrigger render={<Button />}>Open sheet</BottomSheetTrigger>
            <BottomSheetContent title="Report details" description="Resize using the handle or arrow keys.">
              Quarterly report
            </BottomSheetContent>
          </BottomSheet>
        </div>
        <Tour
          open={tourOpen}
          onOpenChange={setTourOpen}
          steps={[
            { target: '#missing-target', title: 'Report' },
            { target: '#missing-target', title: 'Notes' },
          ]}
        />
        <Lightbox
          open={mediaOpen}
          onOpenChange={setMediaOpen}
          items={[
            { src: preview, alt: 'Report preview' },
            { src: preview, alt: 'Notes preview' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </I18nProvider>
  );
}
```

### AspectRatio (`aspect-ratio`)

A box locked to a width / height ratio (16:9 by default) for images, video and embeds; direct children fill it (object-cover). Radius none–xl and an optional bordered placeholder surface.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `AspectRatio` · group Layout · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/AspectRatio/AspectRatio.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/use-render`
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils


### ChatLayout (`chat-layout`)

Full-height chat frame: scrollable thread with auto-scroll that respects scrolling up, a jump-to-latest button, a composer pinned below an optional resizable side panel (artifact or details), and an inline-start history sidebar from md up. sidebarWidth defaults to 280px. For small screens, the app puts history in a Drawer; ChatLayout does not open one automatically.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/chat` · export `ChatLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/chat/src/ChatLayout/ChatLayout.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: window splitter
- Install: `gntik-ui add chat-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject chat-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through the thread, the composer, the resize handle and the panel |
| ArrowLeft | On the resize handle: widens the side panel (Shift for bigger steps) |
| ArrowRight | On the resize handle: narrows the side panel |
| Home | On the resize handle: panel to its maximum width |
| End | On the resize handle: panel to its minimum width |

Tokens: background, foreground, card, border, primary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { ChatComposer } from '@gntik-ai/chat';
import { ChatMessage } from '@gntik-ai/chat';
import { ChatLayout } from '@gntik-ai/chat';

export default function ChatLayoutWithPanel() {
  return (
    <div className="h-[480px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border">
      <ChatLayout
        header={<div className="px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-semibold">Quarterly usage review</div>}
        panel={
          <div className="p-4 text-[13px]">
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-foreground">Details</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">Project web-app · 3 members · 12 deployments this week.</p>
          </div>
        }
        composer={<ChatComposer onSubmit={() => {}} hint={null} />}
      >
        <ChatMessage role="user" timestamp="10:02">
          Which project used the most build minutes this quarter?
        </ChatMessage>
        <ChatMessage role="assistant" timestamp="10:02" copyText="web-app used 1,240 build minutes, 46% of the total.">
          web-app used 1,240 build minutes, 46% of the total.
        </ChatMessage>
      </ChatLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Grid (`grid`)

Responsive CSS grid. `cols` takes 1–12 or a per-breakpoint object ({ base, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl }) mapped to static classes; `minChildWidth` auto-fills as many columns as fit. GridItem spans columns (also responsive, or `full`). gap, rowGap and columnGap accept scalar or per-breakpoint spacing steps (0–12). Tables contain full literal classes for Tailwind scanning.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Grid` · group Layout · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Grid/Grid.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/use-render`
- Registry dependencies: stack, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add grid`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject grid`

Usage:

```tsx
import { Grid } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const PROJECTS = ['Billing API', 'Search', 'Mobile app', 'Data pipeline', 'Docs site', 'Status page'];

export default function GridAutoFill() {
  return (
    <Grid as="ul" minChildWidth="12rem" gap={3} aria-label="Projects">
      {PROJECTS.map((p) => (
        <li
          key={p}
          className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground"
        >
          {p}
        </li>
      ))}
    </Grid>
  );
}
```

### Resizable (`resizable`)

Split layouts with draggable dividers: ResizablePanelGroup (horizontal or vertical), ResizablePanel (default / min / max size in %, collapsible) and ResizeHandle (optional grip). Pointer drag and full keyboard support; the layout can be remembered in localStorage with `autoSaveId`. No extra dependencies.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Resizable` · group Layout · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Resizable/Resizable.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: window splitter
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add resizable`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject resizable`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | Horizontal group: shrinks / grows the panel before the handle by `step` (default 5%) |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Vertical group: shrinks / grows the panel above the handle by `step` |
| Home / End | Sets the panel before the handle to its minimum / maximum size |
| Enter | Collapses the adjacent collapsible panel, or restores it to its previous size |

Tokens: border, primary, card, muted-foreground, shadow-sm, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizeHandle } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function ResizableSplit() {

        </ResizablePanel>
        <ResizeHandle aria-label="Resize draft and preview" />
        <ResizablePanel minSize={20}>
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center bg-secondary/40 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">
            Preview
          </div>
        </ResizablePanel>
      </ResizablePanelGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### ScrollArea (`scroll-area`)

Native scroll container with thin token-styled scrollbars that fade in on hover and while scrolling. Vertical, horizontal or both; optional bordered surface. With an aria-label the viewport is a named region, and it joins the Tab order whenever it overflows.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `ScrollArea` · group Layout · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/ScrollArea/ScrollArea.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/scroll-area`
- ARIA pattern: region
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add scroll-area`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject scroll-area`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focuses the scrollable viewport (only when its content overflows) |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End | Scrolls the focused viewport natively |

Tokens: border, muted-foreground, card, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { ScrollArea } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const EVENTS = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: i,
  who: ['Ada Lovelace', 'Grace Hopper', 'Alan Turing', 'Katherine Johnson'][i % 4],
  what: ['deployed Billing API', 'invited 2 members', 'paid invoice INV-0' + (40 + i), 'rolled back Search'][i % 4],
  when: `${i + 2} min ago`,
}));

export default function ScrollAreaActivity() {
  return (
    <ScrollArea bordered aria-label="Recent activity" className="h-64 max-w-[420px]">
      <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
        {EVENTS.map((e) => (
          <li key={e.id} className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-[13px]">
            <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-foreground">
              <span className="font-medium">{e.who}</span> <span className="text-muted-foreground">{e.what}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{e.when}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </ScrollArea>
  );
}
```

### Section (`section`)

A painted content region (<section>, named by its title). Variants plain / card / muted, padding none–lg (scalar or per-breakpoint object from base through 2xl), optional dividers between children, and a header slot with title, description and actions. Responsive padding updates root, header, body and divided header spacing together; divided bodies keep gap-0 and use divider padding for spacing. Scalar lg remains p-6 sm:p-8; an explicit sm entry overrides sm:p-8. Static literal tables keep every class visible to Tailwind.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Section` · group Layout · status stable

- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add section`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject section`

Tokens: card, card-foreground, secondary, border, foreground, muted-foreground, shadow-sm, radius-xl

Usage:

```tsx
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function SectionResponsivePadding() {

    <div data-responsive-example className="space-y-4">

        variant="card"

        description={t('responsive.sectionDescription')}
        padding={{ base: 'sm', md: 'lg' }}
        divided
      >
        <p>{t('responsive.sectionBody')}</p>
        <p>{t('responsive.fullWidth')}</p>
      </Section>
      <Section
        variant="muted"
        title={t('responsive.overrideTitle')}
        padding={{ base: 'lg', sm: 'sm', md: 'none', lg: 'md', '2xl': 'lg' }}
      >
        <p>{t('responsive.overrideBody')}</p>
      </Section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Stack (`stack`)

Flex layout primitives: Stack (any direction), HStack, VStack and Center. Responsive direction, gap, align, justify and wrap, plus padding, paddingInline and paddingBlock on the 0–12 spacing scale. Mobile-first objects use base, sm, md, lg, xl and 2xl; omitted base direction defaults to column and wrap to nowrap. Other omitted base values add no class; HStack centres only when align is undefined. HStack and VStack keep their fixed direction and reverse; single values keep their existing classes. Also supports inline; render as any block tag with `as`, or any element with `render`. Paints nothing.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Stack` · group Layout · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Stack/Stack.doc.ts

```tsx
      </VStack>

}
```

### VisuallyHidden (`visually-hidden`)

Screen-reader-only content (sr-only), with a `focusable` variant that appears while focused. SkipLink is the canonical use: the first Tab stop on a page, revealed on focus, that moves focus to the main content.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `VisuallyHidden` · group Layout · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/VisuallyHidden/VisuallyHidden.doc.ts

- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add visually-hidden`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject visually-hidden`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focuses the SkipLink and reveals it (first Tab stop on the page) |
| Enter | Moves focus to the target (e.g. <main>), not just the scroll position |

Tokens: card, border, foreground, shadow-md, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { SkipLink } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function SkipLinkPage() {
  return (
    <div className="relative max-w-[560px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-background">
      <SkipLink targetId="skip-link-demo-main" className="focus:absolute" />

        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
          Projects
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
          Members
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
          Billing
        </Button>
      </nav>
      <div id="skip-link-demo-main" className="px-4 py-5 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground focus:outline-none">
        Press Tab inside this preview: the skip link appears first and jumps straight here.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Breadcrumbs (`breadcrumbs`)

Location trail in a nav landmark: chevron or slash separators, an optional icon-only root, and the current page marked with aria-current. With `maxItems` the middle collapses into an ellipsis button that expands the full trail in place.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Breadcrumbs` · group Navigation · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumbs.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: breadcrumb

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus through the links and the ellipsis button; the current page is not a link |
| Enter | Follows the focused link |
| Enter / Space | On the ellipsis button: reveals the hidden levels and focuses the first one |

Tokens: foreground, muted-foreground, secondary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx

        { label: 'Home', href: '/', icon: Home, hideLabel: true },

        { label: 'web-frontend', mono: true },
      ]}
    />

```

### ConversationList (`conversation-list`)

Presentational conversation history with local-calendar recency groups, disclosures, inline rename, sibling row menus, unread counts, New chat and incremental loading. Supply items and handlers; persistence and shortcuts belong to the app. getHref opts into links. groupBy=false preserves input order; a function groups by its returned key. Controlled activeId/collapsedGroups and their default counterparts are supported. Recency collapse keys are today, yesterday, previous7Days and older; custom groups use their returned key. Supply now for stable SSR. Above virtualizeAt (100), measured rows are windowed with the tab stop retained; give the list a bounded height. Uses a roving list of buttons/links, not a listbox: unlike NavList, individual rows are not separate Tab stops. New chat and Load more are separate stops outside the nav. loadingMore keeps Load more focusable but aria-disabled and busy.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/chat` · export `ConversationList` · group Navigation · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/chat/src/ConversationList/ConversationList.doc.ts
- Primitive: `MoreMenu · Input · Badge · Kbd · useVirtualWindow`
- ARIA pattern: navigation with disclosures and roving focus
- Install: `gntik-ui add conversation-list`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject conversation-list`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Enter the nav on the active row, else the first enabled row; the next Tab leaves it, including after using sibling row actions |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Move through headings and enabled rows in visual order; skip collapsed rows |
| Home / End | Move to the first / last heading or enabled row |
| Enter / Space | Activate an enabled row once, or toggle a group heading |
| ArrowRight (ArrowLeft in RTL) | From a row, focus its sibling More actions trigger |
| ArrowLeft (ArrowRight in RTL) / Escape | From the actions trigger, return to the row; Escape in a menu closes it |
| F2 | Start rename when onRename is provided; the title is selected |
| Enter in rename | Save a trimmed, nonempty changed title and return focus to the row |
| Escape in rename | Cancel editing and return focus to the row |

Tokens: foreground, muted-foreground, accent, border, primary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { MessageSquare } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useChatI18n } from '@gntik-ai/chat';
import { ConversationList } from '@gntik-ai/chat';
import { exampleNow, useExampleConversations } from '@gntik-ai/chat';

/** Application state drives this presentational list; no storage or key binding is built in. */
export default function ConversationListGrouped() {
  const { tc, t } = useChatI18n();
  const initial = useExampleConversations();
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>('a');
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    },
    [],
  );
  return (
    <div className="h-[440px] max-w-sm rounded-lg border border-border py-2">
      <ConversationList
        items={items.map((item) => ({
          ...item,
          icon: <MessageSquare size={16} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />,
        }))}
        now={exampleNow}
        activeId={active}
        onActiveChange={(id) => {
          setActive(id);
          setItems((list) => list.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, unread: 0 } : item)));
        }}
        collapsedGroups={collapsed}
        onCollapsedGroupsChange={setCollapsed}
        onRename={(id, title) => setItems((list) => list.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, title } : item)))}
        onDelete={(id) => setItems((list) => list.filter((item) => item.id !== id))}
        itemActions={(item) => [
          {
            label: t('common.copy'),
            onSelect: () => {
              void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(item.title).catch(() => {});
            },
          },
        ]}
        emptyState={<p className="p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{tc('chat.historyExampleEmpty')}</p>}
        onNew={() => {
          const id = `new-${Date.now()}`;
          setItems((list) => [{ id, title: tc('chat.newChat'), updatedAt: exampleNow }, ...list]);
          setActive(id);
          setCollapsed((keys) => keys.filter((key) => key !== 'today'));
        }}
        newShortcut="⌘N"
        hasMore={hasMore}
        loadingMore={loading}
        onLoadMore={() => {
          setLoading(true);
          timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
            setItems((list) => [
              ...list,
              { id: 'loaded', title: tc('chat.historyExampleNumber', { number: 5 }), updatedAt: new Date(2026, 0, 1) },
            ]);
            setLoading(false);
            setHasMore(false);
          }, 600);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### CursorPagination (`cursor-pagination`)

See the cursor-pager-footer block example for data-table paginated={false} with a consumer-owned token stack. Stateless Previous/Next navigation for consumer-owned cursor stacks, with no page numbers, ranges or invented totals. Supply a plain-text summary (null keeps it empty) or shownCount with required labels.shownSummary and labels.totalSummary; only a positive exact total uses totalSummary. A pageSizeOptions select requires pageSize, onPageSizeChange, labels.rowsPerPage and labels.rowsPerPageLabel. Flat previousLabel, nextLabel and ariaLabel override labels.previous, labels.next and labels.navLabel, then provider catalog defaults. loading and busy are aliases: rendered buttons stay focusable and aria-disabled with aria-busy, while the select stays enabled. loadingLabel defaults to the catalog; null keeps the summary during busy. One persistent polite status writes once per changed text; mount, empty text and unchanged commits do not announce. Removal of the focused control moves focus to Next, Previous, the select or the nav root, in that order, even while busy; focus elsewhere never moves.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `CursorPagination` · group Navigation · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/CursorPagination/CursorPagination.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/button + @base-ui/react/select (kit Button and SimpleSelect)`
- ARIA pattern: named navigation landmark with one persistent polite atomic status
- Registry dependencies: button, select, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add cursor-pagination`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject cursor-pagination`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves through the select (when present), Previous and Next, including aria-disabled buttons |
| Enter / Space | Activates an available button once; busy and unavailable buttons do nothing; opens the select |
| ArrowDown / ArrowUp | Opens the select and moves between page-size options |
| Enter / Escape | Selects the highlighted page size or closes the select; focus returns to its trigger |

Tokens: card, border, foreground, muted-foreground, secondary, focus-ring, background, primary, ring, popover, popover-foreground, primary-text

Usage:

```tsx
import { CursorPagination } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function Busy() {
  return (
    <CursorPagination hasPrevious hasNext loading summary="25 records loaded" onPrevious={() => {}} onNext={() => {}} />
  );
}
```

### Link (`link`)

Styled anchor in brand green, underlined by default so inline links do not rely on colour (WCAG 1.4.1); standalone links (nav, cards, actions) pass underline="hover" or "none". `external` adds the external icon, a hidden "opens in a new tab" hint and safe rel/target. LinkProvider supplies the app router link so internal links navigate client-side; `render` swaps the element per link.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Link` · group Navigation · status stable
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/Link/Link.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/use-render`
- ARIA pattern: link
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add link`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject link`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter | Follows the link |
| Tab | Moves focus to and from the link |

Tokens: primary-text, muted-foreground, foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import type { ComponentPropsWithRef } from 'react';
import { Link, LinkProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

/**
 * Stand-in for a router's Link (Next.js, React Router, TanStack…). A real adapter maps `href`
 * to the router's prop (e.g. `to`) and navigates on the client.
 */
function RouterLink(props: ComponentPropsWithRef<'a'>) {
  return <a data-router-link="" {...props} />;
}

export default function LinkRouter() {
  return (
    <LinkProvider component={RouterLink}>
      <nav aria-label="Project" className="flex gap-4 text-[13px]">
        <Link href="/projects">Projects</Link>
        <Link href="/projects/new">New project</Link>
        <Link href="https://status.example.com" external>
          Status page
        </Link>
      </nav>
    </LinkProvider>
  );
}
```

### MegaMenu (`mega-menu`)

Top navigation with wide panels: items with sections open a panel of link columns with descriptions and optional featured content; plain items are links. Hover or click opens, the panel resizes between items, router links come from LinkProvider and the current page is marked. Use it as the StackedLayout sub-nav row; `megaMenuNavItems` feeds MobileNav. Built-in labels follow I18nProvider (en/es); caller overrides take precedence. See the TransferList catalog defaults example for a live Spanish preview of this component.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `MegaMenu` · group Navigation · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/MegaMenu/MegaMenu.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/navigation-menu`
- ARIA pattern: disclosure navigation (nav landmark, triggers with aria-expanded)
- Registry dependencies: link, nav-list, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add mega-menu`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject mega-menu`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves between top-level items, then into an open panel |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown | Opens the panel of the focused trigger |
| ArrowRight / ArrowLeft | Moves between top-level items |
| Escape | Closes the panel and returns focus to its trigger |

Tokens: popover, popover-foreground, border, accent, accent-foreground, secondary, primary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MegaMenu } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { megaMenuItems } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function MegaMenuBasic() {
  const [href, setHref] = useState('#deployments');
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-chrome px-2 py-1.5">
        <MegaMenu
          label="Product"
          items={megaMenuItems}
          currentHref={href}
          onNavigate={(link) => {
            if (link.href) setHref(link.href);
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">Current page: {href}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### MobileNav (`mobile-nav`)

Small-screen navigation: a menu icon button opens a Drawer sheet (chrome surface) with the NavList groups and an optional footer slot. Activating an item closes the sheet; focus is trapped while open and returns to the button.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `MobileNav` · group Navigation · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/MobileNav/MobileNav.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/drawer`
- ARIA pattern: modal dialog containing a navigation landmark
- Registry dependencies: button, drawer, nav-list, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add mobile-nav`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject mobile-nav`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | On the menu button: opens the sheet and moves focus inside |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Cycles through the sheet (focus is trapped) |
| Enter | Follows the focused link and closes the sheet |
| Escape | Closes the sheet and returns focus to the menu button |

Tokens: chrome, popover, border, accent, accent-foreground, primary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { BarChart3, CreditCard, FolderKanban, Home, Rocket, Settings, Users } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { NavGroup } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { MobileNav } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const GROUPS: NavGroup[] = [
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      { label: 'Overview', href: '#overview', icon: Home },
      { label: 'Projects', href: '#projects', icon: FolderKanban, badge: 12 },
      { label: 'Deployments', href: '#deployments', icon: Rocket },
      { label: 'Analytics', href: '#analytics', icon: BarChart3 },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Admin',
    items: [
      { label: 'Members', href: '#members', icon: Users },
      { label: 'Billing', href: '#billing', icon: CreditCard },
      { label: 'Settings', href: '#settings', icon: Settings },
    ],
  },
];

export default function MobileNavBasic() {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState('#projects');
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-chrome px-3 py-2.5">
      <MobileNav
        title="Acme Cloud"
        groups={GROUPS}
        currentHref={current}
        onNavigate={(item) => item.href && setCurrent(item.href)}
      />
      <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">Acme Cloud</span>
      <span className="ms-auto font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{current.slice(1)}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### NavList (`nav-list`)

Vertical navigation for sidebars and settings pages: labelled (optionally foldable) groups of items with icon, label and badge, nested collapsible sub-items, and aria-current="page" on the active item with the brand accent bar. `collapsed` turns it into an icon rail with tooltips (nested sections open as flyout menus). Links render through LinkProvider, so client routers work. Matching defaults to strict href equality (including query/hash). Opt in with list-wide match="prefix" or item.match; an item override takes precedence. Prefix matching ignores query/hash and a trailing slash, respects segment boundaries, and matches / only at the root. Item.pattern accepts a string or array: :name matches one non-empty segment and a final * matches zero or more remaining segments; other * segments are literal, never regular expressions. One computed item wins across groups and descendants: exact href first, then the longest matching href or pattern by segment count, with document-order ties. Explicit current:false excludes an item; any current:true suppresses computation. Matched descendants open their section and activate its rail flyout. NavListRouteMatching demonstrates /functions/fn-42, inherited prefix matching, exact overrides and dynamic project patterns. Exported matchesNavPath, matchesNavPattern, resolveCurrentNavItem and isNavItemCurrent are pure and router-agnostic.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `NavList` · group Navigation · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/NavList/NavList.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/collapsible`
- ARIA pattern: navigation landmark with disclosure sections
- Registry dependencies: link, menu, tooltip, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add nav-list`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject nav-list`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves through items, group toggles and section toggles in order |
| Enter | Follows the focused link (or runs the item button) |
| Enter / Space | On a group heading or nested section: expands or collapses it |
| Enter / Space (rail) | Opens a nested section as a flyout menu (arrow keys move, Escape closes) |

Tokens: chrome, accent, accent-foreground, primary, primary-text, secondary, border, muted-foreground, foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Braces, FileText, Folder, Home, PanelLeft, PanelsTopLeft } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState, type ComponentPropsWithRef } from 'react';
import { useI18n } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { LinkProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { SimpleSelect } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { TooltipProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { NavList, type NavGroup } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
// Keep preview navigation local, without requiring a router or reloading the catalog.
function PreviewLink({ onClick, ...props }: ComponentPropsWithRef<'a'>) {
  return (
    <a
      {...props}
      onClick={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClick?.(event);
      }}
    />
  );
}

const locations = [
  '/',
  '/?tab=a',
  '/functions/fn-42',
  '/functions-v2',
  '/functions/templates/7',
  '/projects/42',
  '/projects/42/runs/7',
  '/audit',
  '/audit?page=2',
];

/** Opt-in matching against a real detail location, independent of any router. */
export default function NavListRouteMatching() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [currentHref, setCurrentHref] = useState('/functions/fn-42');
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const groups: NavGroup[] = [
    {
      items: [
        { label: t('navRoute.home'), href: '/', icon: Home },
        { label: t('navRoute.functions'), href: '/functions', match: 'prefix', icon: Braces },
        { label: t('navRoute.templates'), href: '/functions/templates', icon: PanelsTopLeft },
        { label: t('navRoute.audit'), href: '/audit', match: 'exact', icon: FileText },
        {
          label: t('navRoute.projects'),
          icon: Folder,
          items: [
            {
              label: t('navRoute.project'),
              href: '/projects',
              match: 'exact',
              pattern: ['/projects/:id', '/projects/:id/*'],
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];
  return (
    <LinkProvider component={PreviewLink}>
      <TooltipProvider>
        <div data-example="nav-list-route-matching" className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-4">
          <SimpleSelect
            label={t('navRoute.location')}
            items={locations.map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))}
            value={currentHref}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              if (value) setCurrentHref(value);
            }}
          />
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={PanelLeft}
            aria-expanded={!collapsed}
            onClick={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
          >
            {t(collapsed ? 'nav.expandSidebar' : 'nav.collapseSidebar')}
          </Button>
          <NavList
            key={currentHref}
            groups={groups}
            onNavigate={(item) => {
              if (item.href) setCurrentHref(item.href);
            }}
            currentHref={currentHref}
            match="prefix"
            collapsed={collapsed}
            label={t('navRoute.navigation')}
          />
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </LinkProvider>
  );
}
```

### Pagination (`pagination`)

Moves through pages of results. Pagination is numbered (first, last, siblings of the current page and ellipses, constant width) and page-size agnostic: page, pageCount, onPageChange. PaginationCompact is the table-footer form: "1–10 of 97" with previous/next.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Pagination` · group Navigation · status stable

| --- | --- |

| Enter / Space | Activates the focused control and changes page |

Tokens: primary, primary-foreground, card, border, ring, secondary, muted-foreground, foreground, focus-ring

```tsx

export default function PaginationNumbered() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(6);

}
```

### Stepper (`stepper`)
