```tsx
import { cn } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
```

## Layouts

### AuthLayout (`auth-layout`)

Sign-in, sign-up and reset shell in three variants: `split` (brand panel on the chrome surface + form; the panel hides below `lg` and the logo moves above the form), `card` (form centred in a card) and `full-bleed` (form straight on the chrome surface). The logo defaults to the ThemeProvider brand preset (Logo with wordmark). The form is first in the DOM, so it is first in tab order on every screen size. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `AuthLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/AuthLayout/AuthLayout.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (main, labelled brand aside) + skip link
- Registry dependencies: theme, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add auth-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject auth-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Skip link first, then the form fields in order, then the footer links |
| Enter on the skip link | Moves focus to the form region |

Tokens: background, chrome, card, card-foreground, border, muted-foreground, primary-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Mail } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Input } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Link } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { AuthLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function AuthLayoutCard() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="h-[520px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <AuthLayout
        variant="card"
        skipLinkLabel="Skip to reset form"
        footer={<Link href="#sign-in">Back to sign in</Link>}
      >
        <h1 className="text-[20px] font-semibold tracking-tight">Reset your password</h1>
        <p className="mt-1.5 mb-6 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          Enter the email on your account and we will send you a reset link.
        </p>
        <form
          className="flex flex-col gap-4"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setSent(true);
          }}
        >
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
            <Input type="email" leadingIcon={Mail} placeholder="you@example.com" autoComplete="email" />
            <FieldDescription>The link expires after 30 minutes.</FieldDescription>
          </Field>
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full">
            Send reset link
          </Button>
          <p aria-live="polite" className="h-4 text-center text-[12.5px] text-success-text">
            {sent ? 'Check your inbox for the reset link.' : ''}
          </p>
        </form>
      </AuthLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### CanvasLayout (`canvas-layout`)

Editor shell for a full-bleed canvas (flow editor, code editor, map): top bar · left palette · canvas with a floating toolbar · right inspector · collapsible bottom console. Palette and inspector toggle from the top bar; each panel is controllable (`paletteOpen`, `inspectorOpen`, `consoleOpen`). Below `lg` the side panels and toggles hide and a read-only notice ("Open on a larger screen to edit") shows over the canvas. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `CanvasLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/CanvasLayout/CanvasLayout.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (header, main, two labelled asides, labelled console region) + disclosure buttons
- Registry dependencies: button, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add canvas-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject canvas-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Skip link first, then the top bar, the panel toggles, the palette, the canvas, the console and the inspector |
| Enter / Space on a panel toggle | Shows or hides the palette or inspector (aria-expanded reflects the state) |
| Enter / Space on the console bar | Collapses or expands the console (aria-expanded) |

Tokens: background, foreground, chrome, card, border, secondary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Database, GitBranch, Globe, Maximize, Minus, Play, Plus, Save, Trash2, Webhook } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Button, IconButton } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Field, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Input } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Toolbar, ToolbarButton, ToolbarSeparator } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { CanvasLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const PALETTE = [
  { label: 'HTTP trigger', icon: Globe },
  { label: 'Webhook', icon: Webhook },
  { label: 'Branch', icon: GitBranch },
  { label: 'Database query', icon: Database },
];

const NODES = [
  { id: 'trigger', label: 'HTTP trigger', kind: 'Trigger', x: 48, y: 72 },
  { id: 'branch', label: 'Route by plan', kind: 'Branch', x: 260, y: 150 },
  { id: 'query', label: 'Load project', kind: 'Query', x: 480, y: 80 },
];

const LOGS = [
  ['12:04:31', 'info', 'Validated 3 nodes and 2 edges'],
  ['12:04:32', 'info', 'Dry run started for deployment “billing-sync”'],
  ['12:04:33', 'warn', 'Node “Load project” has no timeout; using 30s'],
] as const;

export default function CanvasLayoutFlowEditor() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState('branch');
  const node = NODES.find((n) => n.id === selected);
  return (
    <div className="h-[520px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <CanvasLayout
        header={
          <>
            <span className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">billing-sync</span>
            <Badge tone="neutral" size="sm">
              Draft
            </Badge>
            <div className="ms-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" icon={Save}>
                Save
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm" icon={Play}>
                Run
              </Button>
            </div>
          </>
        }
        toolbar={
          <Toolbar aria-label="Canvas tools" variant="floating">
            <ToolbarButton icon={Plus} aria-label="Zoom in" />
            <ToolbarButton icon={Minus} aria-label="Zoom out" />
            <ToolbarButton icon={Maximize} aria-label="Fit view" />
            <ToolbarSeparator />
            <ToolbarButton icon={Trash2} aria-label="Delete selection" />
          </Toolbar>
        }
        palette={
          <ul className="grid gap-1">
            {PALETTE.map(({ label, icon: Icon }) => (
              <li key={label}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-2.5 py-2 text-start text-[12.5px] transition-colors hover:bg-secondary focus-ring motion-reduce:transition-none"
                >
                  <Icon size={15} aria-hidden className="text-muted-foreground" />
                  {label}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        }
        inspector={
          node ? (
            <div className="grid gap-4">
              <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                {node.kind} · {node.id}
              </p>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Name</FieldLabel>
                <Input key={node.id} size="sm" defaultValue={node.label} />
              </Field>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Timeout (seconds)</FieldLabel>
                <Input size="sm" type="number" defaultValue="30" />
              </Field>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted-foreground">Select a node to edit it.</p>
          )
        }
        console={
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
            {LOGS.map(([time, level, text]) => (
              <li key={time} className="flex gap-3 px-3 py-1.5">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{time}</span>
                <span className={level === 'warn' ? 'text-warning-text' : 'text-primary-text'}>{level}</span>
                <span>{text}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        }
        consoleActions={<IconButton icon={Trash2} size="sm" label="Clear console" />}
      >
        <div className="relative size-full bg-background">
          <svg aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 size-full">
            <path d="M 208 98 C 240 98, 230 176, 260 176" className="fill-none stroke-border" strokeWidth={2} />
            <path d="M 420 176 C 450 176, 450 106, 480 106" className="fill-none stroke-primary" strokeWidth={2} />
          </svg>
          {NODES.map((n) => (
            <button
              key={n.id}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={selected === n.id}
              onClick={() => setSelected(n.id)}
              style={{ left: n.x, top: n.y }}
              className="absolute w-40 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-start shadow-sm transition-colors aria-pressed:border-primary focus-ring motion-reduce:transition-none"
            >
              <span className="block font-mono text-[10px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">
                {n.kind}
              </span>
              <span className="block text-[12.5px] font-medium">{n.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </CanvasLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### DocsLayout (`docs-layout`)

Documentation shell: top bar · left nav (a NavList) · article · right table of contents. The `Outline` sub-component is the table of contents: scroll-spy with IntersectionObserver (rooted in the article column, guarded where it is missing) marks the heading in view with aria-current="location", and activating a link moves focus to the heading. Below `lg` the nav hides and the table of contents moves into a Collapsible above the article. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `DocsLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/DocsLayout/DocsLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/collapsible (small-screen table of contents)`
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (header, nav, main, "On this page" nav) + disclosure
- Registry dependencies: collapsible, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add docs-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject docs-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Skip link, top bar, left nav, the article, then the table of contents links |
| Enter on a table of contents link | Scrolls to the heading and moves focus to it |
| Enter / Space on "On this page" | Small screens: expands or collapses the table of contents |

Tokens: background, foreground, chrome, card, border, primary, primary-text, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, BookOpen, Rocket, Settings, Shield } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { Badge } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Link } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { NavList, type NavGroup } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Logo } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { DocsLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const NAV: NavGroup[] = [
  {
    label: 'Get started',
    items: [
      { label: 'Introduction', href: '#docs-intro', icon: BookOpen },
      { label: 'Deploy a project', href: '#docs-deploy', icon: Rocket, current: true },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Guides',
    items: [
      { label: 'Environments', href: '#docs-environments', icon: Settings },
      { label: 'Access control', href: '#docs-access', icon: Shield },
    ],
  },
];

const TOC = [
  { id: 'deploy-prerequisites', label: 'Prerequisites' },
  { id: 'deploy-configure', label: 'Configure the project' },
  { id: 'deploy-variables', label: 'Environment variables', level: 3 as const },
  { id: 'deploy-ship', label: 'Ship it' },
];

const PARAGRAPH = 'text-[14px] leading-7 text-muted-foreground';
const H2 = 'mt-10 mb-3 scroll-mt-6 text-[18px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground';

export default function DocsLayoutGuide() {
  return (
    <div className="h-[520px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <DocsLayout
        header={
          <>
            <Logo size={22} wordmark />
            <Badge tone="neutral" size="sm">
              Docs
            </Badge>
          </>
        }
        nav={<NavList label="Documentation" groups={NAV} />}
        toc={TOC}
        footer={
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-[13px]">
            <Link href="#docs-intro" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ArrowLeft size={14} aria-hidden /> Introduction
            </Link>
            <Link href="#docs-environments" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              Environments <ArrowRight size={14} aria-hidden />
            </Link>
          </div>
        }
      >
        <p className="font-mono text-[11px] tracking-[0.18em] text-primary-text uppercase">Get started</p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 text-[28px] font-bold tracking-[-0.02em]">Deploy a project</h1>
        <p className={`mt-3 ${PARAGRAPH}`}>Go from a repository to a running deployment in a few minutes.</p>
        <h2 id="deploy-prerequisites" className={H2}>
          Prerequisites
        </h2>
        <p className={PARAGRAPH}>
          A workspace where you are an owner or a member with deploy rights, and a repository with a build script.
        </p>
        <h2 id="deploy-configure" className={H2}>
          Configure the project
        </h2>
        <p className={PARAGRAPH}>
          Pick the region closest to your users. Builds run in the same region, so caches stay warm between deployments.
        </p>
        <h3 id="deploy-variables" className="mt-6 mb-2 scroll-mt-6 text-[15px] font-semibold text-foreground">
          Environment variables
        </h3>
        <p className={PARAGRAPH}>
          Secrets are encrypted at rest and only exposed to the build and runtime of the environment they belong to.
        </p>
        <h2 id="deploy-ship" className={H2}>
          Ship it
        </h2>
        <p className={PARAGRAPH}>
          Push to the default branch. Each push creates a deployment with its own preview URL; promote it when the
          checks pass.
        </p>
      </DocsLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### InspectorLayout (`inspector-layout`)

Main area with a pinnable right panel (properties, details, comments). Pinned, the panel docks beside the content; unpinned, it overlays it (flat shadow) and Escape closes it. Open and pinned states are controllable; an InspectorToggle placed in the main area opens and closes it. Below lg the panel opens as a bottom Drawer. Fills its container.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `InspectorLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/InspectorLayout/InspectorLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/drawer (small screens)`
- ARIA pattern: disclosure (toggle → complementary panel) + toggle button (pin)
- Registry dependencies: button, drawer, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add inspector-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject inspector-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | On the panel toggle: opens or closes the panel (aria-expanded); an overlaying panel takes focus |
| Enter / Space | On Pin panel: docks or un-docks the panel (aria-pressed) |
| Escape | Closes the unpinned panel and returns focus to the toggle |
| Escape | Small screens: closes the bottom drawer |

Tokens: background, card, border, foreground, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { InspectorLayout, InspectorToggle } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const SERVICES = ['web-frontend', 'billing-api', 'auth-service', 'search-indexer'];

export default function InspectorLayoutProperties() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState('billing-api');
  return (
    <div className="h-[460px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <InspectorLayout
        panelTitle="Properties"
        defaultPinned={false}
        panel={
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-2.5 text-[13px]">
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Service</dt>
            <dd className="font-mono">{selected}</dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Region</dt>
            <dd>eu-west</dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Replicas</dt>
            <dd className="font-mono">3</dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Owner</dt>
            <dd>Platform team</dd>
          </dl>
        }
      >
        <div className="flex h-12 items-center justify-between border-b border-border/60 px-4">
          <h2 className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Services</h2>
          <InspectorToggle label="Toggle properties" />
        </div>
        <ul className="grid gap-2 p-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {SERVICES.map((name) => (
            <li key={name}>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={name === selected}
                onClick={() => setSelected(name)}
                className="w-full rounded-[10px] border border-border bg-card p-4 text-start font-mono text-[13px] hover:bg-accent/45 focus-ring aria-pressed:border-primary"
              >
                {name}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </InspectorLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Page (`page`)

The page inside any shell: a header (a custom slot such as the blocks PageHeader, or a simple h1 + description + actions), the body, and an optional sticky action bar (a labelled region) pinned to the bottom of the scroll container. Widths: narrow 640 · default 1120 · wide 1440 · full. It renders no <main>; the shell owns it.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `Page` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/Page/Page.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: document structure (h1 + region for the action bar)
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add page`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject page`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Follows the reading order: header actions, body, then the sticky action bar |

Tokens: card, border, foreground, muted-foreground

Usage:

```tsx
import { Plus } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Page } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function PageSettings() {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="h-[420px] overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-background">
      <Page
        width="narrow"
        title="Project settings"
        description="General configuration of web-frontend."
        actions={
          <Button variant="secondary" icon={Plus}>
            Add domain
          </Button>
        }
        actionBar={
          <>
            <span aria-live="polite" className="me-auto text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">
              {saved ? 'Changes saved' : 'Unsaved changes'}
            </span>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSaved(false)}>
              Discard
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => setSaved(true)}>Save changes</Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {['General', 'Domains', 'Environment variables', 'Danger zone'].map((section) => (
          <section
            key={section}
            aria-labelledby={`page-example-${section}`}
            className="rounded-[10px] border border-border bg-card p-4"
          >
            <h2 id={`page-example-${section}`} className="text-[14px] font-semibold">
              {section}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-muted-foreground">Settings for {section.toLowerCase()}.</p>
          </section>
        ))}
      </Page>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### PrintLayout (`print-layout`)

Printable document frame for invoices, reports and receipts: an A4 or Letter page (`size`) with margins (`margin`), header and footer slots and a `PageBreak` helper. On screen it is a paper sheet (bg-card / text-card-foreground, border, shadow-sm) on a muted backdrop in the current theme; `print:` variants drop the chrome (no backdrop, border, shadow or outer padding) and an `@page` rule sets paper size and margins (`pageRule`). The header and footer print once, at the top and end of the document. The consuming app should print with the light theme (ThemeProvider `defaultMode="light"`, or `setMode('light')` before `window.print()`); no print-only colours are defined.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `PrintLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/PrintLayout/PrintLayout.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: landmark (main) + labelled article
- Registry dependencies: csp-provider, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add print-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject print-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| — | None: a static document (the skip link still moves focus to it) |

Tokens: card, card-foreground, secondary, border, muted-foreground

Usage:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableFooter,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Logo } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { PageBreak, PrintLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const LINES = [
  { item: 'Team plan · 12 seats', qty: '12', amount: 240 },
  { item: 'Compute · 1,840 vCPU-hours', qty: '1,840', amount: 92 },
  { item: 'Bandwidth · 420 GB', qty: '420', amount: 21 },
  { item: 'Log retention · 30 days', qty: '1', amount: 15 },
];

const money = (n: number) => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
const total = LINES.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.amount, 0);

export default function PrintLayoutInvoice() {
  return (
    <div className="h-[560px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <PrintLayout
        aria-label="Invoice INV-2026-0042"
        pageRule={false}
        header={
          <>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Logo size={26} wordmark />
              <p className="text-[11.5px] leading-snug text-muted-foreground">
                Example Cloud Ltd · 1 Market Street
                <br />
                billing@example.com
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-end">
              <h1 className="text-[22px] font-semibold tracking-tight">Invoice</h1>
              <p className="font-mono text-[11.5px] text-muted-foreground">INV-2026-0042</p>
              <Badge tone="success" size="sm" className="mt-2">
                Paid
              </Badge>
            </div>
          </>
        }
        footer="Thank you for your business. Questions about this invoice: billing@example.com"
      >
        <dl className="mb-8 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-[12px]">
          <div>
            <dt className="font-mono text-[10.5px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Billed to</dt>
            <dd className="mt-1 font-medium">Acme Workspace</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="font-mono text-[10.5px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Period</dt>
            <dd className="mt-1">1 – 30 Sep 2026</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="font-mono text-[10.5px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Issued</dt>
            <dd className="mt-1">1 Oct 2026</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
        <Table>
          <TableCaption srOnly>Invoice line items</TableCaption>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Item</TableHead>
              <TableHead align="right">Quantity</TableHead>
              <TableHead align="right">Amount</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {LINES.map((l) => (
              <TableRow key={l.item}>
                <TableCell>{l.item}</TableCell>
                <TableCell align="right" className="font-mono text-[12px]">
                  {l.qty}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell align="right" className="font-mono text-[12px]">
                  {money(l.amount)}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
          <TableFooter>
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={2} className="font-semibold">
                Total
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell align="right" className="font-mono text-[12.5px] font-semibold">
                {money(total)}
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          </TableFooter>
        </Table>
        <PageBreak />
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-[15px] font-semibold">Usage detail</h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
          Compute is billed per vCPU-hour across all deployments in the workspace, rounded to the nearest hour.
        </p>
      </PrintLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### SettingsLayout (`settings-layout`)

Settings shell: section nav (NavList groups) on the left · a content column with the page title and form sections · a sticky save bar slot (Discard · Save changes). Set saveBar='none' to remove the bar wrapper and its reserved space. Omitted or null slots render no wrapper; empty strings and fragments retain their empty wrapper. The current section is controllable with `value` / `onValueChange`; `href` items navigate as links and still report the change. Below `lg` the nav becomes a Select at the top of the page. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `SettingsLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/SettingsLayout/SettingsLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/select (small screens)`
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (labelled nav, main) + select-only combobox on small screens
- Registry dependencies: nav-list, select, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add settings-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject settings-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Skip link, then the section nav items, then interactive content and the save bar; saveBar='none' has no bar focus stops |
| Enter | Opens the focused section (aria-current="page" moves to it) |
| Enter / Space / ↓ on the section Select | Small screens: opens the list; arrows move, Enter picks a section |

Tokens: background, foreground, card, border, muted-foreground, primary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { Bell, CreditCard, KeyRound, User, Users } from '@gntik-ai/icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Card, CardBody, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Input } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import type { NavGroup } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Switch } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { SettingsLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const GROUPS: NavGroup[] = [
  {
    label: 'Account',
    items: [
      { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: User },
      { id: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications', icon: Bell },
      { id: 'security', label: 'Security', icon: KeyRound },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      { id: 'members', label: 'Members', icon: Users, badge: 12 },
      { id: 'billing', label: 'Billing', icon: CreditCard },
    ],
  },
];

const TITLES: Record<string, [string, string]> = {
  profile: ['Profile', 'How other members see you across the workspace.'],
  notifications: ['Notifications', 'Choose what we email you about.'],
  security: ['Security', 'Sign-in methods and active sessions.'],
  members: ['Members', 'Invite people and manage their roles.'],
  billing: ['Billing', 'Plan, payment method and invoices.'],
};

export default function SettingsLayoutWorkspace() {
  const [section, setSection] = useState('profile');
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [title, description] = TITLES[section] ?? ['Settings', ''];
  const edit = () => {
    setDirty(true);
    setSaved(false);
  };
  return (
    <div className="h-[520px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <SettingsLayout
        groups={GROUPS}
        value={section}
        onValueChange={setSection}
        title={title}
        description={description}
        saveBar={
          <>
            <p aria-live="polite" className="me-auto text-[12.5px] text-muted-foreground">
              {dirty ? 'You have unsaved changes' : saved ? 'All changes saved' : ''}
            </p>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={!dirty} onClick={() => setDirty(false)}>
              Discard
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              disabled={!dirty}
              onClick={() => {
                setDirty(false);
                setSaved(true);
              }}
            >
              Save changes
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {section === 'notifications' ? (
          <Card>
            <CardHeader divided>
              <CardTitle as="h2">Email</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Sent to the address on your profile.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="grid gap-4">
              <Switch label="Deployment failures" defaultChecked onCheckedChange={edit} />
              <Switch label="Weekly usage digest" onCheckedChange={edit} />
              <Switch label="New member requests" defaultChecked onCheckedChange={edit} />
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <Card>
            <CardHeader divided>
              <CardTitle as="h2">Personal details</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Your name and email are visible to workspace members.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Full name</FieldLabel>
                <Input defaultValue="Alex Morgan" onValueChange={edit} />
              </Field>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
                <Input type="email" defaultValue="alex@example.com" onValueChange={edit} />
                <FieldDescription>We send a confirmation link when it changes.</FieldDescription>
              </Field>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        )}
      </SettingsLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### SidebarLayout (`sidebar-layout`)

Application shell: a collapsible sidebar (expanded, 64px icon rail or off-canvas) with header, body and footer slots, a topbar (workspace switcher, breadcrumb, ⌘K, notifications, theme, user menu) and the main region. Below lg the sidebar moves into a left Drawer opened from the topbar menu button. The collapsed state is controllable and can persist in localStorage (storageKey). Fills its container; fullScreen switches to h-dvh.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `SidebarLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/SidebarLayout/SidebarLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/drawer`
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (complementary sidebar, banner topbar, main) + skip link + disclosure toggle
- Registry dependencies: button, drawer, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add sidebar-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject sidebar-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab (first stop) | Reveals the skip link; Enter moves focus to <main> |
| Enter / Space | On the collapse toggle: collapses or expands the sidebar (aria-expanded reflects it) |
| Enter / Space | On the menu button (small screens): opens the navigation drawer and moves focus inside |
| Escape | Closes the navigation drawer and returns focus to the menu button |

Tokens: chrome, background, foreground, border, card, primary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { LinkProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { NavList } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { NavigateContext, DemoRouterLink } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { TooltipProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { WorkspaceSwitcher } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Logo } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { ThemeProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { SidebarLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { DemoTopbar, NAV_GROUPS, WORKSPACES, pageTitle } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function SidebarLayoutApp() {
  const [path, setPath] = useState('/projects');
  const [workspace, setWorkspace] = useState('acme');
  const title = pageTitle(path);
  return (
    // Apps mount ThemeProvider / LinkProvider once at the root; they are local so the example stands alone.
    <ThemeProvider storageKey={null}>
      <NavigateContext value={setPath}>
        <LinkProvider component={DemoRouterLink}>
          <TooltipProvider>
            <div className="h-[560px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
              <SidebarLayout
                mainId="sidebar-layout-main"
                storageKey="example-sidebar-collapsed"
                sidebarHeader={({ collapsed }) =>
                  collapsed ? (
                    <Logo size={26} />
                  ) : (
                    <WorkspaceSwitcher
                      className="w-full"
                      workspaces={WORKSPACES}
                      currentId={workspace}
                      onSelect={(w) => setWorkspace(w.id)}
                    />
                  )
                }
                sidebar={({ collapsed, closeDrawer }) => (
                  <NavList
                    groups={NAV_GROUPS}
                    currentHref={path}
                    collapsed={collapsed}
                    label="Workspace"
                    onNavigate={closeDrawer}
                  />
                )}
                sidebarFooter={({ collapsed }) =>
                  collapsed ? null : (
                    <div className="rounded-[10px] border border-border bg-card p-2.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11.5px] font-semibold">
                        <span aria-hidden className="size-[7px] rounded-full bg-primary" />
                        Control plane
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Operational · 99.98%</div>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                topbar={<DemoTopbar page={title} />}
              >
                <div className="px-6 py-6">
                  <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h1>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">12 projects · 3 environments · eu-west</p>
                  <div className="mt-6 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                    {['web-frontend', 'billing-api', 'auth-service', 'search-indexer', 'media-worker', 'reports'].map(
                      (name) => (
                        <div key={name} className="rounded-[10px] border border-border bg-card p-4">
                          <div className="font-mono text-[13px] font-semibold">{name}</div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">Deployed 2h ago</div>
                        </div>
                      ),
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </SidebarLayout>
            </div>
          </TooltipProvider>
        </LinkProvider>
      </NavigateContext>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

### SplitLayout (`split-layout`)

Master–detail layout: a resizable list pane beside a detail pane, built on ResizablePanelGroup (sizes can persist with autoSaveId). Below lg only one pane shows: the list, or the detail with a Back button; `showDetail` is controllable so selecting an item can switch panes. Both panes are labelled regions. Fills its container.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `SplitLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/SplitLayout/SplitLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `Resizable (role="separator")`
- ARIA pattern: window splitter + two labelled regions
- Registry dependencies: button, resizable, ui-utils
- Install: `gntik-ui add split-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject split-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Arrow Left / Right | On the resize handle: shrinks / grows the list pane (from Resizable) |
| Home / End | On the resize handle: list pane to its minimum / maximum size |
| Enter / Space | On Back (small screens): returns to the list and moves focus to it |

Tokens: background, card, border, accent, muted-foreground, primary, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { StatusTag } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { SplitLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const STATUSES = {
  paid: { label: 'Paid', tone: 'success' },
  due: { label: 'Due', tone: 'warning' },
  overdue: { label: 'Overdue', tone: 'destructive' },
} as const;

const INVOICES = [
  { id: 'INV-2044', customer: 'Northbeam Labs', amount: '$4,210.00', status: 'paid', due: 'Oct 12' },
  { id: 'INV-2043', customer: 'Vega Robotics', amount: '$1,940.00', status: 'due', due: 'Oct 08' },
  { id: 'INV-2042', customer: 'Acme Industries', amount: '$862.50', status: 'paid', due: 'Oct 02' },
  { id: 'INV-2041', customer: 'Orbit Freight', amount: '$318.00', status: 'overdue', due: 'Sep 28' },
] as const;

export default function SplitLayoutInvoices() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string>(INVOICES[0].id);
  const [showDetail, setShowDetail] = useState(false);
  const invoice = INVOICES.find((i) => i.id === selected) ?? INVOICES[0];
  return (
    <div className="h-[460px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <SplitLayout
        listLabel="Invoices"
        detailLabel="Invoice details"
        showDetail={showDetail}
        onShowDetailChange={setShowDetail}
        listHeader={<h2 className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Invoices</h2>}
        detailHeader={<h2 className="font-mono text-[13px] font-semibold">{invoice.id}</h2>}
        list={
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 p-2">
            {INVOICES.map((inv) => (
              <li key={inv.id}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-current={inv.id === selected ? 'true' : undefined}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelected(inv.id);
                    setShowDetail(true);
                  }}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-start hover:bg-accent/55 focus-ring aria-[current=true]:bg-accent"
                >
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block font-mono text-[12.5px] font-semibold">{inv.id}</span>
                    <span className="block truncate text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">{inv.customer}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[12px]">{inv.amount}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        }
        detail={
          <div className="space-y-4 p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">{invoice.amount}</span>
              <StatusTag status={invoice.status} statuses={STATUSES} />
            </div>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-[13px]">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Customer</dt>
              <dd>{invoice.customer}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Due</dt>
              <dd>{invoice.due}</dd>
            </dl>
          </div>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### StackedLayout (`stacked-layout`)

Top-navigation shell: a chrome navbar (brand · primary links or a custom `nav` slot such as a MegaMenu · actions), an optional tab sub-nav row, an optional page-header band and centered content (narrow 640 · default 1120 · wide 1440 · full) with an optional footer. Below lg the links collapse into a MobileNav drawer. Fills its container; fullScreen switches to h-dvh.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `StackedLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/StackedLayout/StackedLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/drawer`
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo) + skip link
- Registry dependencies: link, mobile-nav, nav-list, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add stacked-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject stacked-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab (first stop) | Reveals the skip link; Enter moves focus to <main> |
| Tab | Moves through the navbar links (the current one has aria-current="page") and actions |
| Enter (nav slot) | In the `nav` slot: follows the slot component's own contract (e.g. MegaMenu opens a panel) |
| Enter / Space | On the menu button (small screens): opens the navigation drawer |
| Escape | Closes the navigation drawer and returns focus to the menu button |

Tokens: chrome, background, card, accent, accent-foreground, border, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MegaMenu, megaMenuNavItems, type MegaMenuItem } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Logo } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { ThemeProvider } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { ThemeCycleButton } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { StackedLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const items: MegaMenuItem[] = [
  { label: 'Overview', href: '#overview' },
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    sections: [
      {
        title: 'Build',
        links: [
          { label: 'Projects', href: '#projects', description: 'Every project, its environments and owners.' },
          { label: 'Deployments', href: '#deployments', description: 'Releases, rollbacks and deploy gates.' },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  { label: 'Docs', href: '#docs' },
];

export default function StackedLayoutMegaMenu() {
  const [href, setHref] = useState('#projects');
  return (
    <ThemeProvider storageKey={null}>
      <div className="h-[420px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
        <StackedLayout
          mainId="stacked-mega-main"
          brand={<Logo size={24} wordmark />}
          nav={<MegaMenu items={items} currentHref={href} onNavigate={(link) => link.href && setHref(link.href)} />}
          links={megaMenuNavItems(items)}
          currentHref={href}
          onNavigate={(item) => item.href && setHref(item.href)}
          actions={<ThemeCycleButton />}
        >
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">Projects</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">
            The `nav` slot puts a MegaMenu in the top bar on large screens; the same items feed the drawer on small
            ones.
          </p>
        </StackedLayout>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

### StatusLayout (`status-layout`)

Full-page status for 404, 403, 500 and maintenance: a centred message with a `heading` slot replacing `title` for exactly one page h1; `titleRef` on the built-in h1 enables focus() with tabIndex=-1 outside the Tab order. With no heading, `title` remains required and renders as today. Supply either title or a non-empty heading, never both; the slot must contain exactly one h1. The slot is full width within the centred column and uses the foreground token. For a PageHeader slot, set as="div", breadcrumbs={null}, meta={[]}, tabs={null}, actions={[]}, status="" and description={null} to disable demo fixtures; keep the description on StatusLayout so it appears once. Pass titleRef to PageHeader (or a ref and tabIndex=-1 to a generic h1) and call ref.current.focus() on route load when needed. Keep slot links and actions empty so the primary action stays first in main’s Tab order. Code stays above the heading, with description, illustration or icon halo, primary and secondary actions, optional Logo header and footer unchanged. `tone` colours the code and halo with severity tokens; brand green is only for positive states. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `StatusLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/StatusLayout/StatusLayout.doc.ts
- ARIA pattern: landmarks (header, main, footer) + skip link
- Registry dependencies: ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add status-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject status-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Skip link, header links, then the primary action first and the secondary action next, then the footer |
| Programmatic focus | titleRef.current.focus() focuses the built-in h1; for a heading slot, use the heading node’s own ref (PageHeader titleRef). Neither h1 is a Tab stop |

Tokens: background, foreground, secondary, border, muted-foreground, primary-text, warning-text, destructive-text, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { StatusLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

export default function StatusLayoutHeading() {
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    titleRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  return (
    <StatusLayout
      fullScreen
      code="404 · Not found"
      heading={
        <h1 ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1} className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">
          Page not found
        </h1>
      }
      description="Check the address or head back to the dashboard."
      primaryAction={
        <Button render={<a href="#dashboard" />} nativeButton={false}>
          Go to dashboard
        </Button>
      }
      secondaryAction={
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => window.history.back()}>
          Go back
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### WizardLayout (`wizard-layout`)

Focus-mode shell: title and Exit, Stepper, step body, Back / Next and Finish. mode="page" is the unchanged default (container height, or fullScreen for h-dvh). mode="overlay" is a controlled Base UI modal: open/onOpenChange keep the parent page mounted without navigation; size defaults to "fullscreen" at every viewport, while "dialog" reuses Dialog xl sizing and fills mobile viewports. Use page for a dedicated flow, fullscreen for a focused in-page flow, or the dialog-wizard block (default "dialog") for a compact create flow. Closing never resets the consumer-controlled current step or data. Exit, Escape and Cancel on step zero use confirmExit (default true). Outside presses are ignored unless closeOnInteractOutside is true, then use the same exit confirmation. returnFocusRef overrides focus return to the opener. Each step focuses its heading, first control or body, then announces via a separate polite live region. Supply stepAnnouncement({position,total,label}) from your i18n (required for rich step labels); positions are one-based. All action labels, stepsSummaryLabel and pendingLabel are overridable with i18n fallbacks. finishPending or nextLoading disables Finish and shows pendingLabel in overlay mode. stepsInteractive defaults to true; false omits onStepClick so completed steps are display-only. stepStatusText and formatStepCount pass through to both Stepper variants for localized status words and position text. backDisabled locks Back using aria-disabled while keeping it focusable, including on step zero; it cannot activate Cancel. This does not affect Exit. Below lg, Stepper uses its compact summary. An empty stepAnnouncement suppresses the overlay live region so a composition can announce through its nearest LiveAnnouncer instead; heading focus is preserved.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/ui` · export `WizardLayout` · group Layout · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layouts/WizardLayout/WizardLayout.doc.ts
- Primitive: `@base-ui/react/dialog + @base-ui/react/alert-dialog (exit confirmation)`
- ARIA pattern: page landmarks or modal dialog with labelled step nav + nested alertdialog
- Registry dependencies: alert-dialog, button, dialog, stepper, ui-utils, visually-hidden
- Install: `gntik-ui add wizard-layout`; own the source with `gntik-ui eject wizard-layout`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Skip link, Exit, completed steps, the step body, then Back and Next |
| Enter / Space on Back / Next | Moves to the previous / next step (Finish on the last one) |
| Escape | Opens the exit confirmation (keys inside portalled popups are ignored) |
| Enter on Exit | Opens the exit confirmation; Leave confirms, Stay or Escape closes it |
| Tab / Enter on the Stepper | Moves between completed steps; Enter goes back to one |
| Tab / Shift+Tab in overlay | Wraps inside the modal; closing returns focus to returnFocusRef or the opener |
| Next / Back in overlay | Moves focus to the new step heading or first control, then politely announces the step |

Tokens: background, foreground, card, border, primary, muted-foreground, focus-ring

Usage:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Input } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { RadioGroup, Radio } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { Logo } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { WizardLayout } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

const STEPS = [{ label: 'Details' }, { label: 'Region' }, { label: 'Members' }, { label: 'Review' }];

export default function WizardLayoutNewProject() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [name, setName] = useState('billing-sync');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  return (
    <div className="h-[520px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
      <WizardLayout
        logo={<Logo size={22} />}
        title="New project"
        steps={STEPS}
        current={step}
        onStepChange={setStep}
        nextDisabled={step === 0 && name.trim() === ''}
        onFinish={() => setStatus(`Project “${name}” created`)}
        onExit={() => setStatus('Setup cancelled')}
        exitTitle="Leave project setup?"
        exitDescription="The project has not been created yet. Your answers will be discarded."
        footerStart={<span aria-live="polite">{status}</span>}
      >
        {step === 0 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="wizard-details" className="grid gap-5">
            <h1 id="wizard-details" className="text-[20px] font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Project details
            </h1>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel required>Project name</FieldLabel>
              <Input value={name} onValueChange={setName} />
              <FieldDescription>Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.</FieldDescription>
            </Field>
          </section>
        )}
        {step === 1 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="wizard-region" className="grid gap-5">
            <h1 id="wizard-region" className="text-[20px] font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Where should it run?
            </h1>
            <RadioGroup aria-labelledby="wizard-region" defaultValue="eu-west">
              <Radio value="eu-west" label="EU West · Frankfurt" />
              <Radio value="us-east" label="US East · Virginia" />
            </RadioGroup>
          </section>
        )}
        {step === 2 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="wizard-members" className="grid gap-5">
            <h1 id="wizard-members" className="text-[20px] font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Invite members
            </h1>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel>Emails</FieldLabel>
              <Input placeholder="name@example.com, …" />
              <FieldDescription>You can invite more people later.</FieldDescription>
            </Field>
          </section>
        )}
        {step === 3 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="wizard-review" className="grid gap-3">
            <h1 id="wizard-review" className="text-[20px] font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Review
            </h1>
            <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{name}</span> will be created in EU West with 1 member.
            </p>
          </section>
        )}
      </WizardLayout>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Forgot password form (`forgot-password-form`)

Email (default) or username-or-email password recovery; onSubmit receives the trimmed identifier. Supports identifier (type, autoComplete, label, help/helpId, placeholder, minLength/maxLength), messages (identifierRequired/identifierInvalid/identifierTooShort/passwordRequired), and React 19 ref.focus. The kit owns inline validation and focuses the first invalid field; consumers supply messages, not a second inline validator. Server errors use error + fieldInvalid + feedbackId; aria-describedby describes the form, while flagged inputs also retain their help and error ids. headingLevel (h1/h2/h3/null) suppresses the heading without losing the form name; aria-label/aria-labelledby override the default name. ref.focus accepts identifier. title/description and sentTitle/sentDescription configure request and sent copy; sentTitle, sentDescription, sentStatus and resendActions accept null to hide inbox copy, announcements and resend/change-identifier actions. Preview: forgot-password-form--username-or-email. Optional labels?: Partial<ForgotPasswordFormLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). No provider preserves English; fixtures and caller content stay unchanged. Interactive preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=forgot-password-form--labels.

### Sign-up form (`sign-up-form`)

Account creation with default name/email fields or ordered text/email fields (values.fields), a password strength meter and required consent (terms=false opts out). minPasswordLength defaults to 8 and drives length validation and the insufficient-length meter; optional passwordHelp can receive the minimum. Configured fields support help, required, autoComplete and validation messages, with a linked validation summary on invalid submit. policyLoading renders skeletons without a form; unavailable replaces the form with consumer title, message and optional action. loading remains submitting; error is form-level feedback. Examples: custom-fields, no-terms, unavailable, loading, submitting and error. Optional labels?: Partial<SignUpFormLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). ### Plan card (`plan-card`)

Default billing header retains sample plan, Active status fallback, required monthly price and renewal, monthly/annual per-month pricing and built-in Manage/Upgrade actions. Opt-in variant="summary" uses only consumer data: optional name or emptyLabel, statusLabel, price totals (including zero), cycle, renewal, features and action slots; no sample fallback. See README.md for props, ARIA, keyboard and examples.

| Prop | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| variant | billing (default) \| summary |
| billing plan | BillingPlan: name, priceMonthly and renewsOn required; status, priceAnnual, currency, summary and features optional. Omitted plan uses samplePlan. |
| summary plan | SummaryPlan: all optional: name, statusLabel, statusTone, priceMonthly, priceAnnual, currency, cycle, renewsOn, features. Prices are supplied cycle totals, never multiplied or discounted. |
| emptyLabel | Summary only: consumer label used when the name is absent. |
| actions | Summary only: ReactNode slot of kit Buttons or native links, absent by default. |
| defaultCycle / onCycleChange | Initial monthly (default) or annual selection and cycle callback. |
| titleAs / className | h2 \| h3 (default) \| h4; additional token-backed classes. |
| onUpgrade / onManage / upgradeLabel / manageLabel | Billing only: existing action handlers and labels; both buttons always render. |

Examples:
- [summary-full](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-full)
- [summary-minimal](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-minimal)
- [summary-unassigned](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-unassigned)
- [summary-unassigned-no-label](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-unassigned-no-label)
- [summary-price-only](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-price-only)
- [summary-zero-price](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-zero-price)
- [summary-renewal-only](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-renewal-only)
- [summary-features-only](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-features-only)
- [summary-actions-only](/preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card--summary-actions-only)

- Package: `@gntik-ai/blocks` · export `PlanCard` · group billing · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/blocks/src/billing/PlanCard/block.meta.ts
- ARIA pattern: Heading (titleAs h2/h3/h4), text-labelled Badge, optional features list and native consumer actions. Summary omits absent regions; no heading plus a development warning when name and emptyLabel are absent. ToggleGroup has an accessible Billing cycle label and aria-pressed buttons, rendered only with both prices. Axe coverage in dark, light and high_contrast.
- Composes: Card, Badge, Button, ToggleGroup, Toggle
- Preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=plan-card
- Install: import from `@gntik-ai/blocks`, or copy the source with `gntik-ui add plan-card`

Keyboard:

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move through the cycle toggle (only with both prices) and supplied buttons or links. |
| Arrow keys / Home / End | Move focus within the monthly/annual toggle group. |
| Enter / Space | Activate focused buttons and toggles; Enter activates links. |

Tokens: card, foreground, muted-foreground, border, focus-ring


### Code panel (`code-panel`)

Multi-file code panel with optional readOnly, owned line markers, onValidityChange and onMonacoReady, merging every Monaco marker owner into Problems; the lazy loader example injects inline YAML schemas and same-origin yaml workers under CSP. The open file can be controlled (activeFile, onActiveFileChange) and the heading level set (headingLevel). Optional readOnly prevents editor edits. markers accepts CodePanelMarker entries {id,owner,file,line,column?,endLine?,endColumn?,severity,message,source?}; each owner is reserved for its consumer diagnostics service. The Problems list merges problems, consumer markers, and Monaco model markers from every owner, including worker-backed YAML schema errors. onValidityChange(valid) fires only when errors cross zero (initially clean emits nothing); warnings do not invalidate. onMonacoReady(monaco) configures consumer services once per Monaco instance and may return cleanup. loader can configure monaco-yaml before mounting; the only supported YAML path is consumer-injected, with enableSchemaRequest:false and an inline schema. examples/diagnostics.tsx demonstrates a semantic-worker owner next to schema diagnostics. See packages/editor/README.md for the lazy Vite yaml.worker recipe, Monaco 0.57 compatibility alias, and CSP worker-src self blob: with same-origin scripts and assets. Supplying markers (including []), onMonacoReady or onValidityChange enables model-marker collection; readOnly controls editing independently. Omitting diagnostics extensions preserves the original supplied-problems-only view. No kit runtime dependency on monaco-yaml.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/blocks` · export `CodePanel` · group builders · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/blocks/src/builders/CodePanel/block.meta.ts
- Composes: Tabs, ToggleGroup, Toggle, CodeEditor, DiffEditor
- Preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=code-panel
- Install: import from `@gntik-ai/blocks`, or copy the source with `gntik-ui add code-panel`

Usage:

```tsx
import { CodePanel } from '@gntik-ai/blocks';

// Props default to the block fixtures; pass your data.
<CodePanel />
```

### Flow builder (`flow-builder`)

FlowGraph<Kind> is {nodes,edges}; FlowGraphChange names the edit type and affected nodeIds/edgeIds. Optional onGraphChange(graph, change) reports each committed add, delete, move, connect or inspector update once, omitting selected, dragging and measured from nodes. Inspector updates report every value change: hosts persisting every call should debounce. Selection, measurement, panel resizing, rejected connections and run mode report nothing. Optional graph controls content: render the parent graph without applying edits locally, while selection, measured sizes and active drag positions stay internal by stable node id. nodes/edges remain initial values when uncontrolled. onRun keeps the canvas node objects. builderNodes and builderEdges expose the shared starter graph; cleanFlowGraph(graph) returns a graph without transient node fields for persistence. examples/ControlledGraph.tsx shows graph={graph} onGraphChange={setGraph}. Palette ids skip existing kind-n ids. Visual flow editor with optional nodeTypes for named handles (branch-arm, parallel and sequence examples), onConnectEdge for edge type/data mapping, isValidConnection and onConnectionRejected for rules, onConnect for accepted connections, validationIssues for node/flow problems, mode="run" for a read-only canvas, nodeStatus for live badges, and onNodeSelect for pointer/keyboard selection. Optional nodeTypes registers kit-owned {type, handles:[{id,kind,position?,label?}], render, decorations?} definitions (no React Flow NodeProps). Keep nodeTypes and its renderer definitions stable (module scope or useMemo) across nodeStatus updates: recreating the array rebuilds custom node components and remounts them, defeating per-node memoization. onConnectEdge({source,target,sourceType,targetType,sourceHandle,targetHandle}) returns {type,data}; examples/extensions.tsx maps branch arm-0 to {kind: "branch-arm", armIndex: 0}, parallel branch to {kind: "parallel"}, and sequence next to {kind: "sequence"}. isValidConnection returns true, false, or {code,nodeId?,message}; onConnectionRejected reports {code,nodeId,message} once (nodeId defaults to the source) so consumers can forward it into validationIssues and control its lifetime, while onConnect reports accepted connections only. validationIssues decorates nodes with an icon and accessible text; node issues select and focus their node, and flow issues have no node link. mode="run" removes the Run action, palette, inspector and graph mutation while keeping labelled keyboard-selectable nodes, pan/zoom, fit controls and the wide-screen minimap. nodeStatus maps node IDs to FlowTone badges (running, degraded, failed, paused, done, handoff, review); onNodeSelect(id) handles pointer and keyboard selection. RunFlowExample shows live updates with per-node memoization. FlowNode defaults to the built-in FlowNodeKind union; use FlowNode<string> (or a custom kind union) for custom graphs, inferred by FlowBuilder and WorkflowBuilderPage. Custom renderers use kit status overlays and issue decorations by default; set decorations:"consumer" when render owns them, using data.decoration with accessible text and icons (for example, render:({data}) => <NodeCard title={data.title} tone={data.decoration?.status} />). FlowCanvas showInteractiveControls=false retains zoom/fit without the editing toggle. Named handles are keyboard controls: Enter or Space starts or completes a connection in edit mode; handles are disabled in run mode.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/blocks` · export `FlowBuilder` · group builders · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/blocks/src/builders/FlowBuilder/block.meta.ts
- Composes: FlowCanvas, useFlowState, ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizeHandle, Button, Field, Input, SimpleSelect
- Preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=flow-builder
- Install: import from `@gntik-ai/blocks`, or copy the source with `gntik-ui add flow-builder`

Usage:

```tsx
import { FlowBuilder } from '@gntik-ai/blocks';

// Props default to the block fixtures; pass your data.
<FlowBuilder />
```

### Log viewer (`log-viewer`)

Windowed log stream (role="log"): level filter, search with highlighted matches, follow-tail and per-line copy. Renders only the visible rows. Optional wrap (default false) shows full messages in measured, variable-height rows; rowHeight estimates unmeasured rows. Optional labels?: Partial<LogViewerLabels> overrides each built-in label, including per-level chip and filter names through labels.levels. Explicit content props win over labels, then I18nProvider (en/es); no provider keeps English. Copied log text and imported fixtures stay unchanged. See the Catalog labels and Full messages and level names live previews. Copy actions await the clipboard write; denied or unavailable access shows common.copyFailed (overridden by labels.copyFailed), and only a successful write calls onCopyLine. Both results reset after 1500ms. See the Catalog labels live preview.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/blocks` · export `LogViewer` · group builders · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/blocks/src/builders/LogViewer/block.meta.ts
- Composes: ToggleGroup, Toggle, Input, Switch, IconButton
- Preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=log-viewer
- Install: import from `@gntik-ai/blocks`, or copy the source with `gntik-ui add log-viewer`

Labels (optional Partial per instance; explicit keys override provider translations and defaults):

| Key | Type | State / surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Visible heading and log region name; title prop wins |
| `levelFilter` | `string` | Level filter group name |
| `levels` | `Partial<Record<LogLevel, string>>` | Per-level chip and filter names; omitted levels use the catalog |
| `searchLabel` | `string` | Searchbox name |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` | Searchbox placeholder |
| `follow` | `string` | Follow switch name |
| `count` | `(visible: number, total: number) => string` | Filtered line count |
| `empty` | `string` | No matching lines |
| `inspect` | `(timestamp: string) => string` | Inspect button name when onSelectLine exists |
| `copy` | `(timestamp: string) => string` | Copy button before copying |
| `copyFailed` | `string` | Copy button after a failed write, only on the affected line |
| `copied` | `string` | Copy button after copying |

Usage:

### Chart card (`chart-card`)

A Card with chart and legend: default 7d/30d/90d or custom ranges via ranges, controlled range/onRangeChange, and showRangeToggle={false} when a toolbar owns the range (pass its window as range). Supports title, optional headline and delta, area/line/bar/heatmap charts, and loading, empty and error states. Supply matching dataByRange keys and use defaultRange for initial uncontrolled selection; the toolbar is the only range control when the toggle is hidden. Unknown range/defaultRange keys fall back to the first option for selection, data and label, with a development-only warning. Chart states follow the kit I18nProvider locale automatically through ChartLocaleProvider; standalone charts need their own ChartLocaleProvider (en/es, per-key labels overrides). ### Description list card (`description-list-card`)

### Empty states (`empty-states`)

Four canonical empty states: first run (with checklist), no results (clear filters/search), no access (request access) and not found (optional action). FirstRunEmpty, NoResultsEmpty and NoAccessEmpty accept labels?: Partial<FirstRunEmptyLabels>, Partial<NoResultsEmptyLabels> and Partial<NoAccessEmptyLabels> respectively. Each type has its own keys below; explicit title, description, actionLabel and secondary props win. FirstRunEmpty accepts actionLabel?: string | null: omitting it uses labels.action or the localized default; actionLabel={null} or actionLabel="" hides the primary action and ignores onAction. An empty labels.action also hides it. Combine actionLabel={null}, secondary={null} and steps={[]} for a state with no actions or checklist. See the Hidden action live preview. Defaults follow I18nProvider (en/es). NoResultsEmpty keeps the query in a mono span unless queryTitle replaces the heading. NotFoundEmpty and all imported fixtures stay English. See the Catalog labels live preview. NoAccessEmpty accepts showRequestAccess?: boolean (default true): false hides both the request button and its status announcement, so defaultRequested has no visible effect. action?: { label: string; href: string } renders one kit Link, styled like FirstRunEmpty’s secondary link; it is secondaryAction after the request button, or primaryAction when showRequestAccess is false. With showRequestAccess=false and no action, it renders no actions. Omitting onRequestAccess still shows the button by default. See the Spanish live preview for no actions, a link alone, and a link with the request button.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/blocks` · export `NotFoundEmpty` · group feedback · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/blocks/src/feedback/EmptyStates/block.meta.ts
- Composes: EmptyState, Button, Link
- Preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=empty-states
- Install: import from `@gntik-ai/blocks`, or copy the source with `gntik-ui add empty-states`

Labels (optional Partial per instance; explicit keys override provider translations and defaults):

| Key | Type | State / surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FirstRunEmpty.labels.title` | `string` | FirstRunEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `FirstRunEmpty.labels.description` | `string` | FirstRunEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `FirstRunEmpty.labels.action` | `string` | FirstRunEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `FirstRunEmpty.labels.guide` | `string` | FirstRunEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoResultsEmpty.labels.queryTitle` | `(entity: string, query: string) => string` | NoResultsEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoResultsEmpty.labels.title` | `(entity: string) => string` | NoResultsEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoResultsEmpty.labels.description` | `(filterCount: number) => string` | NoResultsEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoResultsEmpty.labels.clearFilters` | `string` | NoResultsEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoResultsEmpty.labels.clearSearch` | `string` | NoResultsEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoAccessEmpty.labels.title` | `(resource: string) => string` | NoAccessEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoAccessEmpty.labels.description` | `(resource: string, owner: string) => string` | NoAccessEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoAccessEmpty.labels.request` | `string` | NoAccessEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoAccessEmpty.labels.requested` | `string` | NoAccessEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |
| `NoAccessEmpty.labels.sent` | `string` | NoAccessEmpty: per-key override; formatters receive original data. Explicit props win. |

Usage:


### Credential disclosure dialog (`credential-disclosure-dialog`)

Controlled disclosure for an existing credential. Set disclosure ({variant: stored | fresh, credentialId, expiresAt: caller-formatted ReactNode, secret}) only after a successful response; null renders nothing while pending or on failure. Clear disclosure, additionalSecrets and secret-bearing revealContent in onClose to drop every secret; a fresh secret requires a new successful response before showing it again. No pending/error state or internal secret retention. Stored values start masked; each null-to-value opening or changed credentialId/secret resets masking and copy feedback. Fresh values use a non-copyable CodeBlock with a kit CopyButton and a replacement warning, or a masked SecretField when maskFresh is set at session start. Optional additionalSecrets ({id, label, value}) are always masked and use independent toggles and serialized copy actions; ids must be non-empty, unique and not secret, with the first duplicate winning. Multi-secret groups announce label plus copiedLabel, or copiedAnnouncementFor(label); onCopy(id) never receives a value. Every secret and the optional revealContent slot have data-kit-redact. The session key includes additional ids and values. presentation is dialog by default or inline, fixed until the next opening: inline is a named section, never traps focus or handles Escape, and its warning is a non-live note. Surviving focus stays; removing the focused slot or session control focuses the popup or inline heading. Focused inline unmounts return focus through the same resolvers. Dismissed retained props stay hidden; clear and re-set or change a session value to reopen. Optional English defaults through en/es i18n for title, description, credentialIdLabel, expiryLabel, secretLabel, showLabel, hideLabel, copyLabel, copiedLabel, successAnnouncement, failureAnnouncement, warningTitle, warningText and closeLabel. Copy results are announced politely, including manual-selection fallback. Popup initial focus and focus trapping use Base UI; at close, resolveReturnFocus() is validated for connection, visibility, enabled state and focusability, then fallbackFocus(), then the original opener. Synthetic fixtures only; the default Stored preview is masked and the Fresh preview starts closed. Optional labels?: Partial<CredentialDisclosureDialogLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). No provider preserves English; fixtures and caller content stay unchanged. Interactive preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=credential-disclosure-dialog--labels.

- Package: `@gntik-ai/blocks` · export `CredentialDisclosureDialog` · group forms · status beta
- Docs: https://github.com/gntik-ai/gntik-ui/blob/main/packages/blocks/src/forms/CredentialDisclosureDialog/block.meta.ts
- Composes: Dialog, SecretField, CodeBlock, CopyButton, Alert, LiveAnnouncer, Button
- Preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=credential-disclosure-dialog
- Install: import from `@gntik-ai/blocks`, or copy the source with `gntik-ui add credential-disclosure-dialog`

Labels (optional Partial per instance; explicit keys override provider translations and defaults):

| Key | Type | State / surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `description` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `credentialIdLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `expiryLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `secretLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `showLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `hideLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `copyLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `copiedLabel` | `string` | Async feedback |
| `successAnnouncement` | `string` | Async feedback |
| `failureAnnouncement` | `string` | Async feedback |
| `warningTitle` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `warningText` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | Default content and accessible names |
| `copiedAnnouncementFor` | `(label: string, copied: string) => string` | Async feedback |

Usage:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@gntik-ai/ui';
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { CredentialDisclosureDialog, type CredentialDisclosure } from '@gntik-ai/blocks';
import { freshDisclosure } from '@gntik-ai/blocks';

/** Closed on load: no preview or visual baseline exposes the synthetic fresh value. */
export default function Fresh() {
  const [disclosure, setDisclosure] = useState<CredentialDisclosure | null>(null);
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <h1 ref={heading} tabIndex={-1}>
        Credentials
      </h1>
      <Button
        ref={trigger}
        onClick={() => {
          void Promise.resolve({ ...freshDisclosure }).then(setDisclosure);
        }}
      >
        Disclose fresh secret
      </Button>
      <CredentialDisclosureDialog
        disclosure={disclosure}
        onClose={() => setDisclosure(null)}
        resolveReturnFocus={() => trigger.current}
        fallbackFocus={() => heading.current}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### File upload panel (`file-upload-panel`)

Controlled files/onFilesChange (add, progress, done, error, remove, cancel) or defaultFiles; manual uploadMode retains pending File objects for form submission. beforeUpload drops false, replaces a File or rejects without Retry; batches preserve pick order and expose aria-busy. onUpload receives {signal, id}: forward signal to fetch/XHR to stop the transport. Unmount and cancel abort; retry gets a fresh signal. onRemove runs before removal: false or rejection keeps a row, and promises disable its button. Pending rows use locale-aware binary sizes with compact unit labels (4,300 bytes: 4.2 KB); existing uploaded rows retain decimal sizes. Live examples: /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--manual-form and /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--auto-cancel. Drag-and-drop zone with accept/reject MIME feedback (demonstrated in the Labels preview), a Browse button, type and size validation, and a file list with progress, retry and remove. Optional labels?: Partial<FileUploadPanelLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). No provider preserves English; fixtures and caller content stay unchanged. Interactive preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--labels.
